We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
jobs.description:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

• TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)

• Fortune Change the World (2024)

• CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

• Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)

• Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts.

The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.  You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role,  it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams.

As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:

• Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement

• Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio

• Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth.

• Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans.

• Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs.

• Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations.

• Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption.

• Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions.

• Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact.

• Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables.

• Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges.

• Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives.

• Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes.

What we’re looking for you to bring:

• 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes.

• Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred.

• Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes.

• Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change.

• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements.

• History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities.

• Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively.

• Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth.

• Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.

• Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients.

• Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management).

• Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity.

• Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed.

Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job):

• Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space.

• Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred

• Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients.

• Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite.

The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and  Seattle, WA.  For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

• Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.

• Whole-self care through wellness partnerships

• Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days

• 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)

• Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens

• 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

jobs.description:

The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives

jobs.title: Softare Engineer, Consumer Health (Health AI)
jobs.description:
OpenAI’s Health AI team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that help people better understand and navigate their health while setting a high bar for safety, reliability, privacy, and user trust.

On the Consumer Health team, we’re building health experiences directly into ChatGPT. People can use ChatGPT to understand health information, prepare for appointments, make sense of changes over time, and have more informed conversations grounded in their own health context.

Our work sits at the intersection of consumer product engineering, AI, and healthcare. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to build experiences used at global scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for product-minded software engineers to build the next generation of consumer health experiences in ChatGPT.

You will own products and features end-to-end, from early prototypes through polished experiences used by millions of people. We welcome specialists in mobile, frontend, or full-stack development; you can focus on the area where you have the most depth.

This role is ideal for engineers who care deeply about craft and user experience, move quickly from idea to product, and are excited about making complex health information understandable and useful. Prior healthcare or AI experience is not required.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design and build consumer health experiences across ChatGPT, including mobile, web, and full-stack product surfaces.

 - Own features end-to-end, from early product exploration and prototyping through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.

 - Build intuitive experiences for helping people understand and interact with complex personal health information.

 - Work closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and safety experts to translate emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer products.

 - Build experiences that let people connect their medical records, health apps, and connected devices, explore their health over time, and get useful answers grounded in their personal context.

 - Develop reliable systems and interfaces for highly sensitive user data, with privacy and security built into the product experience.

 - Improve product quality, performance, reliability, and usability at ChatGPT scale.

 - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them toward practical, high-quality solutions.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Are an exceptional product engineer who has shipped consumer-facing products and cares deeply about usability, performance, and craft.

 - Have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software.

 - Have deep experience in at least one of mobile, frontend, or full-stack product development.

 - Enjoy working closely with design and product partners and contributing to product direction, not just implementation.

 - Can take ownership of ambiguous problems and move quickly from prototype to production while maintaining a high quality bar.

 - Are excited about the opportunity to use AI to help people better understand and manage their health.

 - Are thoughtful about the responsibilities that come with building products involving sensitive health information.


BONUS IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience building high-quality consumer products at significant scale.

 - Experience building AI-powered or conversational products.

 - Experience working with personal data, health data, wearables, or health platforms such as Apple Health.

 - Experience building products where privacy, safety, and user trust are core product requirements.

 - Previous experience in healthcare or health technology.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

 


JOB OVERVIEW 

The Power Electronics Test & Validation Engineer will own application-specific testing of Heron's solid state transformer (SST) across its core use cases: powering AI data centers, utility-scale BESS, and PV plants. That means bringing up hardware in the lab and at pilot sites, writing scripts to drive test equipment and power converters, and debugging performance against what each application demands, from MPPT performance and PPC/EMS/BMS communication to AI load smoothing and DC protection coordination. You will work hand in hand with the Systems Integration team: they own the SST platform; you own the applications.

 


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Own end-to-end application testing of a novel high C-rate battery pack (SuperBBU) with Heron's SST, validating ripple mitigation, backup capability, slew rates, and power-loss profiles.

 - Support SST and utility-scale BESS integration testing at pilot sites, covering EMS-to-SST communication, black start and grid-forming coordination, charge/discharge cycling, and round-trip efficiency.

 - Support integration testing of the SST with commercial off-the-shelf DAS, SCADA and EMS systems. 

 - Own Heron's first pilot deployments: review field performance, identify feature gaps, and work with SW/FW teams to turn findings into product improvements.

 - Write and maintain Python-based test automation to command power converters, sequence tests, log data, and turn manual procedures into repeatable automated loops.

 - Safely operate power converters, chillers, contactors, and protection hardware, and set up cabling, instrumentation, and data acquisition for high-power test runs.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We have a short list of must-have requirements. We prioritize a strong grip on first principles, hands-on skills, and a sense of initiative. Domain-specific knowledge and experience will help determine the career level for each hire.

 


MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics, energy storage, EV, grid, or a comparable hardware-intensive environment.

 - Strong grasp on DC circuit fundamentals: resonances, parasitics, slew rates, and inductive spikes. You can correlate test data with simulation results.

 - Strong scripting and test-automation skills to drive instruments and power converters and to log and analyze data.

 - Working knowledge of power conversion and battery systems: inverters and converters, BMS, DC pre-charge, contactors and protection, and thermal and cooling loops.

 - Comfort with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, DAQ systems) and comms protocols such as CAN and Modbus TCP.

 - Scrappy mindset: you get things done with a hundred hurdles in front of you.

 


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with solid state transformers or grid-forming inverters.

 - Familiarity with utility-scale BESS commissioning, grid-support functions, or EMS integration.

 - Prior experience in systems-level testing of power electronics or energy storage products

 - Hands-on experience with circuit and system simulation tools such as LTspice, Simscape, or PLECS. 

If you are passionate about the energy transition and enjoy working at the frontier of power electronics and grid integration, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.

Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

We are building advanced augmented dexterity capabilities for next-generation robotic platforms. As a Senior AI/ML Research Engineer (Computer Vision), you will develop the perception models that let our Embodied-AI system understand the surgical scene. Working within a hierarchical, multimodal stack—where a high-level model interprets sensory observations into structured intent and a low-level policy turns that intent into precise, safe, real-time control—you will focus on the vision layer: designing, training, and evaluating models that extract anatomy, instruments, actions, and surgical context from intraoperative video. You will partner with the broader AI/ML team to define how perception feeds reasoning and control, and you will drive the research-to-deployment path for your models, taking them from offline experimentation to robust, real-time performance in the OR.

Working within Intuitive's Future Forward research organization, you will identify, build and finetune the AI/ML models and algorithms that enables us to deliver safe and performant embodied AI systems. This role calls for someone who is equally comfortable getting hands-on with models and data and designing systems that scale.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Develop temporal models for activity and workflow understanding: event/state recognition and fine-grained temporal action segmentation.
• Benchmark in-house models against the state of the art and recommend the target perception architecture.
• Define the perception input/output specification and demonstrate offline feasibility on recorded data.
• Stand up a continuous-improvement loop (discrepancy flagging, active learning, human-in-the-loop relabeling) and the tooling/UI needed for offline evaluation and the path to real-time use.
• Partner with annotation and data teams to shape label taxonomies, QC, and the data pipeline that feeds the AI/ML models.
• Establish the path from offline evaluation on recorded data to real-time integration, including the continuous-improvement (human-in-the-loop) data loop.
• Partner with AI/ML researchers, robotics, data engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver a perception layer that enables rapid prototyping and learning while working toward a product solution.

Minimum Qualifications

• MS or PhD in CS, EE, Robotics, or a related field, with 5+ years of applied computer-vision research experience.
• Strong grasp of modern CV and deep-learning fundamentals: CNNs and vision transformers, segmentation, detection, tracking, and representation/self-supervised learning.
• Demonstrated work in video understanding, including temporal action segmentation, action/phase recognition, and video segmentation.
• Hands-on experience with modern video architectures, including video transformers and self-supervised video pretraining.
• Exposure to vision-action (VA) / vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-model / self-supervised predictive architectures (e.g., JEPA-style models, MAE, DINO) for learning visual representations and dynamics.
• Experience working with large, messy, real-world video datasets at scale.
• Strong software and experimentation skills in Python and C++, with proficiency in one or more of PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX, and the ability to stand up clean, reproducible experiments and run the full loop (data curation, augmentation, loss design, metrics, error analysis).
• A research-and-prototyping mindset: comfortable working in ambiguity, framing open-ended problems, running rapid experiments, and reading and reproducing recent papers to pull promising techniques into practice.
• Sound judgment about the path from prototype to product: writing code others can build on, knowing when to optimize versus when to move fast, and thinking ahead about data quality, evaluation, and robustness even at the research stage.
• Solid foundations in linear algebra, probability, and optimization, enough to reason about and debug model behavior from first principles.
• Comfort collaborating across a multidisciplinary team (ML, robotics, software, and clinical/domain experts) and communicating tradeoffs and findings clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in healthcare, medical devices, surgical robotics, or other regulated technical domains.
• Sim-to-real workflows and experience with robotics simulators (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac)
• Experience with structured, ontology- or taxonomy-based labeling frameworks for fine-grained activity.
• Multimodal fusion of video with sensor, telemetry, and system-log streams.
• Designing annotation pipelines, QC processes, and active-learning loops.
• Real-time / edge inference optimization (e.g., TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson).
• Fine-grained interaction and object-relationship modeling.
• Relevant peer-reviewed publications (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, etc.).

jobs.title: Credentialing Specialist |Onsite- Pittsburgh
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Location: Onsite — 5 Penn Center Blvd, Pittsburgh, PA ( Robinson Township). This role also supports registered employees across our locations in Austin, TX, Chesterfield, MO and Boise, ID.

Hours: Full-time, Monday – Friday. Shift availability between 9am – 5pm.

What You'll Do

This is a rare opportunity to own something from the ground up. As a Pharmacy Registration & Licensing Specialist, you'll be the engine behind one of Blink's most critical compliance functions — ensuring that every pharmacist, pharmacy technician, and regulated support employee is properly licensed, registered, and credentialed to do the work they do. You'll build and maintain the systems that keep us compliant, partner cross-functionally across operations, product, and pharmacy leadership, and help shape what scalable licensing infrastructure looks like at Blink. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who thrives on precision, organization, and building things that last.

Responsibilities

Initial Licensing & Registration

• Manage end-to-end initial licensing and registration for pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, and employees in regulated support roles across all Blink locations

• Support employees with preparation and submission of license applications in compliance with each State Board of Pharmacy's specific requirements

• Coordinate fingerprinting, background checks, and other state-specific onboarding requirements, including managing relationships with outside vendors (e.g., coordinating onsite fingerprinting events)

• Track state-specific protocols, such as pharmacy technician trainee-to-technician transitions, and ensure all required training milestones and documentation are completed before status changes

• Partner with the Training team to align licensing milestones with new hire onboarding timelines and training requirements

• Ensure proper documentation and posting of licenses where required by state law

License Renewals & Ongoing Compliance

• Manage the renewal lifecycle for all individual licenses and registrations—tracking expiration dates and initiating renewal processes well in advance (this role facilitates the process but cannot independently complete renewals on behalf of the individual).

• Proactively monitor license standing to ensure all licenses remain active, in good standing, and free of disciplinary action

• Coordinate proactively with individuals, supervisors and Pharmacists-in-Charge (PICs) when action is required to maintain compliance

• Stay current on state-specific Board of Pharmacy licensing requirements across all jurisdictions where Blink operates and flag any regulatory changes that may impact our workforce

• Work closely with the Licensing Manager on matters that intersect individual and facility licensing

Systems, Recordkeeping & Scalable Infrastructure

• Work with OpEx / PIC to develop and maintain a centralized licensing tracking system from the ground up — starting from existing spreadsheet foundations and evolving toward a scalable solution capable of supporting a workforce that may double or triple in size

• Maintain meticulous, audit-ready records for all employee licenses, registrations, application submissions, renewals, and compliance documentation

• Design and implement tracking processes that provide leadership with real-time visibility into licensing status across all locations and roles

• Identify opportunities to improve recordkeeping processes, reduce manual effort, and increase reliability as the team scales

Pharmacy Software Access & Permissions

• Own the management of employee permissions within Blink's pharmacy software system, ensuring that only appropriately licensed and registered employees have access to regulated tasks and workflows

• Partner actively with Product & Engineering and People & Culture teams to help build and refine the access permission infrastructure currently under development — this person will be a key stakeholder in getting this system across the finish line

• Serve as the operational point of contact for permission-related questions, audits, and access reviews

• Ensure access levels are updated in real time as employees' licensing status changes (new hires, renewals, expirations, role changes)

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Director of Pharmacy Practice, Licensing Manager, and operational team leaders to ensure alignment on licensing requirements and timelines

• Support new hire onboarding by coordinating licensing and registration steps with the Training team and new hire experience

• Serve as a resource for individual employees navigating the licensing or registration process, providing clear guidance and proactive communication throughout

• Collaborate with supervisors across St. Louis, Pittsburgh, Austin, and Boise to ensure site-level compliance and timely action on licensing needs

What You'll Need

• Exceptional attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy — this role is built on precision

• Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously

• Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with teams across operations, pharmacy, training, product, and engineering

• A builder's mindset — the ability to look at a complex, large-scale problem and envision a scalable, sustainable solution

• Comfort working independently and taking ownership of projects from start to finish

• Proficiency with spreadsheets and data organization tools; experience building or improving tracking systems is a plus

• Ability to adapt to changing requirements, regulations, and workflows in a fast-moving environment

• High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a related field is a plus

• No prior licensing or credentialing experience required — we will train the right person

Your Next Chapter at Blink

This role was created because we believe in investing in the people already on our team. We're looking for someone at Blink who has shown up every day with care, accuracy, and a commitment to doing things right — and who is ready for the next step.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished system. You'll build it. You'll leave a mark on how Blink manages one of its most important compliance functions for years to come. And you'll do it with the full support of pharmacy and operations leadership who are actively rooting for your success.

If your manager has seen this in you — or if you see it in yourself — we want to hear from you.

#blinkpatientservices

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Experience Designer
jobs.description:
Title: Senior Digital Experience Designer
Location: St. Louis, MO
Company: Fortune 100 Food & Beverage Manufacturing (FuseGlobal has worked with this company for 20 years)
Initial term: 12 months (position expected to run longer)
Schedule: Monday - Thursday onsite, Friday work from home

To be considered for this position, you must include an online portfolio showing UX/UI, digital product and visual or content-led design work. Thank you!

About This Role:

The Senior Digital Experience Design Specialist is a hybrid designer who bridges product experience design, content design and visual communication. This role creates cohesive, consumer-centered front-end experiences across websites, applications and other digital touchpoints while ensuring that content, interaction and visual expression work together as one experience. The specialist brings in-depth UX/UI expertise and a strong eye for graphic design, messaging hierarchy and brand expression, translating traditional marketing ideas and assets into intuitive, accessible and high-performing digital experiences. Working closely with product, marketing, content and development partners, this role turns consumer needs and business goals into experiences that are useful, engaging, on-brand and feasible to build.

What You'll Do:

• Experience Strategy and UX/UI Design Work on the end-to-end front-end experience for websites, applications, responsive and adaptive experiences and other connected digital touchpoints. Translate consumer needs, business requirements, brand objectives and content priorities into intuitive journeys, information architecture, interaction patterns and polished user interfaces. Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, page layouts and high-fidelity designs that clearly communicate experience and design intent as needed. Apply consumer empathy, research, analytics, KPIs and behavioral signals to identify opportunities, validate design decisions and continuously improve the experience. Rapidly iterate from concept through design handoff, balancing usability, visual quality, brand consistency, technical feasibility and speed to market.

• Content and Visual Design Bring a strong content design mindset to digital experiences, shaping page hierarchy, messaging flow, calls to action, labels and supporting content so consumers can quickly understand and act. Apply graphic design principles, including composition, typography, color, imagery and visual storytelling, to create compelling and cohesive digital experiences. Partner with marketing and creative teams to translate campaign concepts, marketing materials and brand assets into effective digital-first journeys. Assess the quality and fit of content and creative assets within the experience, recommending edits, adaptations or new approaches when needed. Ensure that UX, content and visual design decisions reinforce one another rather than operating as separate workstreams.

• Cross-Functional Work and Delivery Serve as a design team member across product, marketing, content, creative and development teams, championing consumer-centered problem solving. Utilize digital design standards, reusable patterns and experience guidelines, and support consistent adoption across teams and touchpoints. Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, marketers, content strategists and other partners to define visuals and content needs and product content priorities. Communicate effectively with digital product team members; understand front-end constraints and critical paths, and incorporate technical considerations into UX planning. Provide design support throughout development and execution, including design reviews and quality assurance for layout, responsive behavior, typography, interactions, accessibility and overall design integrity.

What You Bring:

• BA, BFA or equivalent experience in UX/UI design, interaction design, visual communication, graphic design, digital design or a related field.

• 5 or more years of experience in UX/UI, product design, digital design, experience design or a related discipline.

• Experience designing within front-end experiences for websites and applications across responsive breakpoints.

• Experience creating both UX deliverables and polished visual design, with a portfolio demonstrating strength in interaction, interface, content hierarchy and graphic design.

• Experience working in Agile Scrum, Lean Kanban or comparable cross-functional product delivery environments.

• Experience contributing to both small and large initiatives from concept through launch and optimization.

• Strong working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud tools.

• Demonstrated experience in user-centered design, interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, responsive design and design systems.

• Strong visual design capabilities, including typography, layout, color, imagery, composition and brand application.

• Ability to evaluate and shape content hierarchy, messaging flow, calls to action and microcopy in partnership with content and marketing teams.

• Working knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design principles for digital experiences.

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with an understanding of front-end development practices and constraints.

• Ability to connect consumer insights and data with pragmatic, structured design decisions.

• Clear communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design rationale to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Highly organized and able to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and deliver within tight deadlines.

• Collaborative, pragmatic and open-minded, with a shared-ownership approach to team success.

• Passion for technology, digital products, consumer experience and the evolving relationship between UX, content and brand design.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Up to $82 per hour + Overtime

• Medical insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance

• 401(k)

• Disability insurance

jobs.title: Orbital Tube Welder
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for an Orbital Tube Welder and Fabrication Technician, reporting to Manufacturing Supervisor, Tube Fabrication, to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of artificial-gravity human-rated space stations.

This will be a full-time, non-exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

Shift schedule:

• First shift: 5:00am - 2:30pm

• Second shift: 2:00pm -10:30pm

Responsibilities:

• Create and follow procedures to setup and operate the orbital welding system

• Work from blueprints and approved drawings

• Work alongside engineering to provide insight to process improvements

• Cut and prepare tubing and fittings used in the welding operation

• Perform setup and maintenance of the welding system

• Assist in training other teammates in orbital tube welding

• Work with final integration teams to weld on vehicle assembly

• Assemble and calibrate liquid controllers and systems as required

• Inspect all completed assemblies using borescope and other inspection tools

• Proofing assemblies per company standards

• Maintain an adequate supply of spare parts for the welding system

• Maintain a clean work area, practicing “clean as you go” and general housekeeping standards

• Assist in facility needs

Minimum Qualifications:

• 3+ year of welding, machining or manufacturing experience OR certificate from an accredited trade skills program in A&P, manufacturing, welding, and/or electronics

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Certification from a formal orbital weld training program

• 3+ years of orbital welding experience

• Clean room experience

• Airframe and powerplant (A&P) license

• TIG welding and clean room experience

• Experience working in an aerospace manufacturing environment

• Strong forklift experience

Additional Requirements:

• Able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Able to stand for extended periods – 8 hours min

• Able to stoop, bend, crawl, and being able to maneuver in tight spaces

• Able to work in small teams to ensure production needs are consistently met

Pay Range: California

$24—$58.20 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS

The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vast is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vast is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Events & Marketing Assistant
jobs.description:
About the Job

Do you love the buzz of a well-run event and the satisfaction of checking every last logistics box before showtime? We're seeking an Events & Marketing Assistant to join our growing team!

Lightspeed Systems has developed solutions to help K–12 school IT departments keep technology safe, secure, and easy to manage. As a part of the Marketing team and reporting to the Events Manager, you'll get our sales team in front of the right people at the right events, and make sure everything behind the scenes runs without a hitch.

As our Events & Marketing Assistant, you will:

• Be a driving force behind our event presence - research the right events, manage registration and logistics, and ensure the sales team is show-ready

• Own the details that keep events running smoothly, from shipping booth materials to coordinating with vendors

• Support broader marketing efforts, including supporting lead conversion, to help fuel our pipeline

About the Role

The following are the essential functions of the position. This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented as necessary:

• Research and identify relevant industry events, conferences, and trade shows aligned with company goals

• Manage event registration - booth space, sponsorships, and attendee sign-ups

• Coordinate event logistics - travel, internal pre-event communication, show service orders (AV, electric, material handling, etc.)

• Help plan event happy hours, including researching and selecting venues, gathering and comparing pricing, and coordinating event details

• Manage shipping and receiving of event materials, booth assets, and promotional collateral, ensuring items arrive on time and intact

• Support post-event follow-up, including lead capture organization and handoff to the marketing/sales funnel

• Support lead conversion - nurture campaign support and CRM data hygiene

• Assist with general marketing tasks and projects as needed, including content coordination and campaign support

• Keep event and marketing records accurate in the CRM

• Perform additional duties and projects as assigned

About You

The following knowledge, experience, skills, abilities, and key behaviors are preferred or required to perform this job.

• 1-2 years in event coordination, marketing, or related client-facing roles; four-year degree required

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and good at managing multiple moving parts at once

• Thrives on logistics, deadlines, and vendor coordination in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• Strong written and verbal communicator

• Self-motivated, resourceful, and reliable, with a proactive problem-solving mindset

• Ability to travel occasionally to support on-site event execution

• Proficient in Microsoft Office

• Salesforce experience, a plus

ABOUT US

With more than 25 years of serving education, Lightspeed Systems delivers the most in-depth visibility and control to power exceptional schools where students are safe and engaged; technology is compliant and easily managed; and resources are secure and optimized. Purpose-built for school networks and devices, Lightspeed’s cloud-managed solutions include the most effective web filtering, student safety monitoring, classroom management, device management, and data analytics software available. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, with a European office in London, UK, Lightspeed serves over 23 million students across 31,000 schools in 43 countries, utilizing 15 million devices. Learn more at www.lightspeedsystems.com.

We love our employees, and we show it. Our benefits and perks are built to support your overall wellbeing—at work and beyond. Offerings vary by country.

ABOUT OUR ATX HQ

If your role includes spending time onsite, you will LOVE being at the ranch. Our uniquely Lightspeed (and totally Texas) corporate headquarters has everything Lightspeeders need to get the job done – and a whole lot more.

• 15,000 sq. ft. of open work area, offices, and huddle rooms

• Snacks galore and a private chef serving up lunch Tuesday through Thursday every week

• A state-of-the-art fitness center (with outfitted locker rooms)

• Physical therapist onsite regularly

• Indoor and outdoor casual collaboration spots

• Pet-friendly office environment

• A golf simulator, go-carts, shuffleboard, corn hole, and MORE fun

All within 31 sprawling acres of Live Oak trees that foster a natural habitat for local wildlife. It is not uncommon to be greeted daily by whitetail deer. (Maybe it wants to join your meeting?)

Lightspeed Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, or other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Knowledge Strategy, Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
   
   

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.



About The Role

EliseAI ships fast, and our knowledge systems need to keep up. We’ve built pipelines that turn support tickets into knowledge and product releases into documentation, along with an AI-powered knowledge surface used daily by Support and Solutions Engineering. Now, we need someone to own the strategy behind these systems and make them more useful as the company grows.



You’ll own our customer-facing help center, internal knowledge experience, and the processes that keep both accurate and current. This role combines strong writing, systems thinking, AI tools, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Solutions, Support, and Implementation to turn what the organization knows into information people can easily find and use.



This role sits on the Product Excellence team and reports to the Head of Product Excellence.



Key Responsibilities

 - Develop and own the strategy and roadmap for EliseAI’s external and internal knowledge experiences

 - Own the coverage, structure, freshness, accuracy, and findability of our customer-facing help center

 - Improve the internal knowledge hub and AI answer surface used by Support and Solutions Engineering

 - Partner with technical teams to strengthen the workflows that turn support tickets, product releases, and lifecycle changes into reliable knowledge

 - Define and track standards for knowledge quality, coverage, usage, and adoption

 - Build repeatable processes that capture knowledge from Product Managers, engineers, Solutions Engineers, and Implementation leads while it is still fresh

 - Use AI tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to design prompts, prototype workflows, and improve how knowledge is created and maintained

 - Build trust across teams and make it easy for subject-matter experts to contribute without slowing them down

jobs.title: Ground Systems Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Mission Software Engineer II is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

Responsibilities

• Own Ground Segment Services: Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.

• Mission Control Interfaces: Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.

• Simulation and Test Automation: Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.

• Build the Mission Platform: Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.

• Deployments Across Environments: Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 3+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

• Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.

• Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.

• End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.

• Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.

• Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).

• Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.

• Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.

• Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.

• Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Software Engineer II: $144,020 - $184,026/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

Benefits

Consider your benefits covered for launch. At Varda, we invest in benefits and perks that support your health, financial well-being, and life beyond work. Benefits vary by position, with packages designed specifically for our regular full-time employees and interns.

Regular Full-Time Positions:

Health & Wellness

• Flexible PTO policy + 12 paid holidays

• 100% company-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for employees and dependents with FSA and employer-matched HSA options

• Voluntary accident, hospital, critical illness, and pet insurance

• $120/month wellness reimbursement for gym and fitness expenses

• 12 weeks of parental leave (with supplemental disability leave for CA mothers)

• Family building, pregnancy, parenting and menopause benefits via Maven Clinic

• Sponsored One Medical memberships for employees and their dependents

Financial & Retirement

• Substantial incentive equity in a fully funded space start-up

• 401(k) retirement plan with 6% employer match (immediately vested)

• $20/pay period cell phone reimbursement

• Relocation support for new hires, if needed

Workplace Experience & Perks

• Fully stocked kitchen with lunch provided daily and dinner provided twice weekly

• Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and mission-success celebrations

• Complimentary EV charging

Benefits for Internship Positions:

Health & Wellness

About This Role

The Senior Mission Software Engineer is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

Responsibilities

• Own Ground Segment Services: Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.

• Simulation and Test Automation: Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Information Officer (CIO)

The Role

The Chief Information Officer (CIO) provides the strategic vision and executive leadership for Plexus' global technology organization, ensuring technology serves as a competitive advantage that accelerates business growth. This role is responsible for the end-to-end strategy, architecture, execution, and optimization of enterprise technology, business systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, software engineering, and digital innovation across the organization.

As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CIO partners across every business function to align technology investments with corporate strategy, enabling Plexus' Vision 30 growth objectives and global expansion. This leader will modernize the organization's technology ecosystem, leverage emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence and automation—and deliver world-class digital experiences for Brand Ambassadors and Customers.

Equally important, the CIO builds and leads a high-performing global technology organization by attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent. This leader fosters a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration, empowering teams to embrace emerging technologies while delivering measurable business outcomes.

This is not a maintenance-focused technology role; it is a transformational leadership opportunity to shape the future of technology for a rapidly growing global organization.

This position requires full-time work from our Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters.

Employee Value Proposition

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Plexus technology as we pursue our Vision 30 to become the world's leading gut health company and achieve $2 billion in revenue. As Chief Information Officer, you won't simply maintain technology; you'll define how it accelerates business growth. You'll lead enterprise-wide digital transformation, evaluate and implement emerging technologies to create lasting competitive advantage, and build scalable platforms that power exceptional experiences for millions of Brand Ambassadors and Customers worldwide.

Partnering closely with an exceptional Executive Leadership Team, you'll influence enterprise strategy, support expansion across APAC, LATAM, and Europe, and champion innovation through artificial intelligence, automation, and modern technology. Just as importantly, you'll build and inspire a world-class technology organization by developing exceptional leaders, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning, and empowering your team to deliver measurable business outcomes.

If you're energized by transforming technology into a strategic competitive advantage, passionate about developing high-performing teams, and excited to leave a legacy on a growing global organization, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of Plexus.

Key Performance Objectives

The successful leader will:

• Deliver a seamless enterprise transition to the organization's next-generation virtual office environment while ensuring minimal business disruption.

• Launch a best-in-class digital shopping experience by year-end that enhances the customer experience, scalability, and business performance.

• Develop and execute a multi-year global technology roadmap that supports international expansion, enterprise scalability, and operational excellence.

• Build a high-performing technology organization by strengthening leadership capability, developing technical talent, improving organizational engagement, and creating succession for critical technology roles.

Performance Accountabilities

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Innovation

• Define and execute the enterprise technology strategy and multi-year roadmap that supports Vision 30 and global business growth.

• Drive digital transformation through emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and advanced analytics, creating measurable business value.

• Establish technology governance that balances innovation, scalability, operational excellence, and return on investment.

Enterprise Platforms & Operations

• Lead the strategy, implementation, and optimization of enterprise applications, digital platforms, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.

• Ensure secure, reliable, and scalable technology operations that deliver exceptional experiences for Brand Ambassadors, Customers, and employees.

• Maintain enterprise cybersecurity, data governance, disaster recovery, and regulatory compliance across global operations.

Leadership & Organizational Excellence

• Build, develop, and retain a high-performing global technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and continuous talent development.

• Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement while accelerating adoption of modern technologies and AI.

• Set clear performance expectations, develop leaders, and deliver measurable outcomes that strengthen organizational capability.

Executive Partnership & Business Stewardship

• Partner with executive leadership to align technology investments with business strategy and measurable organizational outcomes.

• Lead technology financial planning, vendor partnerships, and capital investments to maximize value and operational efficiency.

• Build trusted cross-functional relationships that position technology as a strategic business partner across the enterprise.

Performance Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum 15 years of progressive technology leadership, including 5 years at the Vice President level or above leading enterprise technology organizations.

• Previous Chief Information Officer experience preferred.

• Direct Selling or global consumer products experience is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to align enterprise technology with corporate strategy, global growth, and measurable business outcomes.

• Technology Expertise: Advanced knowledge of enterprise applications, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, software engineering, digital platforms, and infrastructure.

• Digital Transformation: Demonstrated success leading enterprise modernization, AI adoption, automation, and large-scale technology transformation initiatives.

• People Leadership: Exceptional track record in building, coaching, and retaining high-performing technology organizations while fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

• Business & Financial Acumen: Experience leading technology budgets, capital investments, vendor partnerships, and enterprise governance.

• Executive Influence: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to translate complex technology strategies into business value.

• Strategic Decision Making: Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to lead effectively through ambiguity and organizational change.

• Leadership Presence: High emotional intelligence, resilience, adaptability, and the ability to inspire teams while building trust across all levels of the organization.

About Plexus

Founded in gut health. Experts in microbiome. Plexus Worldwide®, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a renowned direct-selling company recognized as a top employer. Over the past 18 years, Plexus has dedicated itself to promoting hope, health, and happiness through its scientifically backed, innovative dietary supplements, weight management products, and personal care products, sold primarily through Plexus Brand Ambassadors. As a six-time Best Places to Work awardee, Blue Zone-approved employer, and an AZ Most Admired Company, Plexus prides itself on its robust organizational culture and commitment to community support and philanthropy. Our team is driven by a shared mission to empower individuals to achieve their health and wellness goals while offering additional income through the sale of products. Join us to be part of a team that values people, innovation, wellness, and community impact.

Benefits

• Highly rated and competitive medical plans.

• 401 (k) with company match and immediate vesting.

• 1-on-1, personalized health coaching.

• Many other voluntary benefits.

To learn more about Plexus Worldwide, please review our careers page at www.plexusworldwide.com/careers.

Learn more about our One Plexus culture. Watch this short video to see how our values, people, and purpose come together to make Plexus a great place to grow and make an impact. https://plexusworldwide-1.wistia.com/medias/zhfpm3vi4o.

Thank you for taking the time to apply for an opportunity with our One Plexus team! If you had any issues during the application process, please get in touch with us directly at careers@plexusworldwide.com.

We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your information. Visit our Candidate Privacy Notice for additional information.

jobs.title: Head of Analyst Relations
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports that mission by explaining our technology, our values, and how we safely build powerful AI. We help business leaders see what AI can make possible for their organizations, show how customers use OpenAI’s products, and explain how AI is changing the way people work.

Analyst Relations sits within Business Communications, helping industry analysts understand our technology, enterprise products, and how organizations put them to work.



About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Analyst Relations to build OpenAI’s global analyst relations program and help influential analysts understand our enterprise products and the business outcomes they enable. You will set the narrative and engagement strategy, focusing on the firms and categories that shape enterprise buying decisions.

This is an exceptionally fast-paced, hands-on role. You will shape long-term positioning, advise senior leaders, and lead our participation in priority evaluations, briefings, and analyst engagement around launches. You will build trusted relationships while bringing Product, Research, Marketing, Sales, and Communications together to make decisions quickly and deliver exceptional work under tight deadlines.

This role reports to the Head of Business Communications. This role will be hybrid, in office 3 days a week, ideally in the San Francisco Bay Area; flexible on New York based candidates.



In this role, you will:

 - Set the global analyst relations strategy, prioritizing the firms, categories, and questions that shape enterprise technology decisions.

 - Lead OpenAI’s work on priority evaluations, from deciding where to engage through submissions, demos, and customer evidence.

 - Build a coherent enterprise narrative across a fast-moving product portfolio, grounded in what ships, customer outcomes, and responsible deployment.

 - Develop trusted, candid relationships with analysts through substantive briefings, regular updates, and follow-through on their questions.

 - Turn analyst feedback and competitive context into useful counsel for product and go-to-market teams, and track whether our positioning and analyst understanding improve.

 - Build a repeatable program with an evaluation calendar, briefing materials, approved customer references, and clear measures of relationship strength and evaluation outcomes.

 - Prepare executives and spokespeople for significant analyst moments, and help Communications and Sales use third-party research accurately in external and customer conversations.



You might thrive in this role, if you have:

 - Deep analyst relations experience in complex enterprise technology, including ownership of major evaluations.

 - A record of building programs with clear priorities and strong relationships, then turning analyst insight into useful counsel for the business.

 - Excellent judgment about what an analyst report says, what evidence supports customer and competitive claims, and what must remain confidential.

 - The credibility to work with technical leaders and make a sophisticated platform story clear to analysts and enterprise buyers.

 - Excellent writing and executive counsel skills, with the ability to align teams without formal authority.

 - A proven ability to move quickly between strategy and hands-on delivery under tight deadlines, while measuring progress through relationship strength, message understanding, and evaluation outcomes.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

The Firmware Engineer II on the Flight Software team is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves & operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. • Develop reliable firmware to control how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate through the entire mission.

• Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.

• Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.

• Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.

• Build highly reliable and available software systems.

• Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) techniques.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• Experience developing and testing real-time embedded hardware / software systems.

• Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of language concepts.

• Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.

• Experience with additional programming languages such as Python or Rust.

• Strong testing expertise, including functional, regression, load, and smoke testing, as well as experience automating test suites.
• Ability to read, understand, and work within an existing codebase before reaching for a rewrite or redesign.

jobs.description:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our Charlotte, NC headquarters (Tuesday through Thursday) and work fully remotely on Mondays and Fridays each week.
