Red Ventures Growth & Transformation empowers partners through a unique blend of high-scale proprietary distribution, data models, AI-enabled applications, and strategic client partnerships. We help our clients unlock significant and sustainable growth across the home services ecosystem, ranging from telecommunications and security to energy and home automation. As a Red Ventures company, we have more than 20 years of experience building strategic, long-standing relationships with some of the world’s most powerful brands across industries like financial services, retail, real estate, and entertainment.

We believe the next phase of advantage will come from integrated operating systems that connect decisioning, execution, intelligence, and governance into a shared foundation that improves over time. RVGT is investing in that future through our Growth Operating System, a set of reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance mechanisms designed to help our teams and our partners drive growth more efficiently, more intelligently, and at greater scale.

Our product organization transforms clients’ customer acquisition, retention, and operations through AI and ML. We are seeking a Group AI Product Manager to own digital for one of our largest clients. In this role, you will lead a team designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-native products and agentic workflows that materially improve our client’s economics. You will translate partner objectives, business strategy, and experimentation insights into clear product roadmaps, while working directly with client stakeholders to shape solutions, align on priorities, and guide key product decisions.

We expect this leader to be deeply technical, analytically rigorous, and relentlessly curious. You should bring a strong grasp of data science practices, the ability to find signal in ambiguity, and the judgment to identify where AI can create meaningful value within the broader partner strategy. You are comfortable operating close to the details, solving complex analytical and technical problems, and being hands-on when needed to drive our hardest challenges.

This role will have significant visibility across our client services division. You will work closely with senior leaders across product, technology, and client teams and serve as a credible strategic partner to the client on the products you lead. You will bring strong product judgment, help stakeholders navigate complex decisions, and build confidence in the path from opportunity to measurable business impact.

What You'll Do

• Identify & drive initiatives: Lead multiple AI product initiatives, ensuring alignment with product leadership, partner objectives, customer needs, and broader RVGT strategy. Develop business cases and assess feasibility, impact, and ROI in partnership with business and client stakeholders

• Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment

• Own outcomes: Own the P&L and business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles

• Advance the Operating System: Build and deploy agentic workflows across your workstreams in partnership with our central teams. Ensure delivery learnings are turned into reusable capabilities that strengthen the broader system over time

• Develop talent: Manage and develop 2+ product manager(s), creating specific plans, providing hands-on product and analytical support, delegating appropriate work, and instilling a performance-driven environment through clear expectations, regular feedback, and recognition of achievements

What We’re Looking For:

• Commercially grounded: You bring an entrepreneurial mindset paired with strong commercial instincts, identifying where value can be unlocked and the levers that drive measurable improvements in business outcomes, connecting product decisions to both near-term value and long-term strategy

• Relationship-driven: You build durable relationships with client counterparts and internal leaders, understanding their motivations and constraints, and using these partnerships to shape decisions, secure alignment, and accelerate impact

• Technical fluency: You have a strong technical and data foundation that enables you to collaborate effectively with engineers and data scientists, understand relevant algorithms, translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product development

• Customer centric: High-level of customer empathy with the ability to diagnose the core of the problem. You have a great taste for UX and design to help bring solutions to life

• Deeply curious: You have a genuine drive to understand how the world is changing and how emerging AI capabilities can be applied in practice. You invest time in staying close to new developments, forming clear opinions on what makes systems effective, and bringing that perspective into product strategy, team leadership, and execution

Experiences You've Had:

• End-to-end ownership: Experience driving AI/ML products from concept through iteration, guiding a team through delivery, and owning the outcomes and business impact of the work

• Driving complex decision-making: Experience influencing cross-functional leaders, navigating competing priorities, and making high-impact product decisions in ambiguous, fast-paced environments

• Built from experience: You’ve worked hands-on with production-grade AI systems, whether evaluating model behavior, running analyses (sql, python), building agents, or optimizing data pipelines, giving you the practical grounding to lead teams and make informed technical decisions

• Partner engagement: Experience serving as a strategic partner to stakeholders or clients, leading discovery conversations, validating opportunities, and aligning teams around shared goals

• People leader: Managed junior product managers (or adjacent roles) with direct responsibility for their development and success

Compensation:

Total Cash Compensation Range: $185,000-$230,000

This role is eligible for a target bonus, which is included in the Total Cash Compensation Range above. This role is also eligible for Equity, which is offered separately from the Total Cash Compensation Range listed above. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.

Who We Are:

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, and more. Across the portfolio, Red Ventures businesses deliver seamless digital experiences for consumers, help Fortune 100 clients solve large-scale digital growth challenges, and create world-class experiences and opportunities for employees. Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Location: Onsite, 400 South Woods Mills Rd, Suite 100, Chesterfield MO

Hours: Fulltime, 40 hrs/week, 4 10 hr shifts, 7am-5pm; Sunday- Wednesday or Wednesday- Saturday

Responsibilities:

• Responsible for the supervision of pharmacy technicians in support of the pharmacy manager involved in the pharmacy workflow

• Oversee data entry by pharmacy staff from providers and receiving pharmacies and insure the quality of the pharmacy technicians work

• Ensure confidentiality of patient information and their records, and destruction of relevant documentation which contains patient information

• Assist the pharmacy manager in overseeing staff in fielding calls from major pharmacy chains and independent pharmacies across the country

• Assist the pharmacy manager staff in receiving, processing and transferring patients’ prescriptions, and own the success of the transfer end-to-end

• Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a high-volume closed-door fulfillment environment, ensuring accuracy of drug, dose, quantity and labeling prior to dispensing

• Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy

• Provide proactive patient counseling and medication education via phone, addressing questions related to new prescriptions, refills, side effects, adherence, and proper mediation use

• Collaborate with prescribers and their offices to clarify prescriptions and address clinical issues that may delay dispensing

• Perform all tasks in a safe and compliant manner that is consistent with corporate policies as well as State and Federal laws

• Work collaboratively with St Louis Pharmacy leadership, Pharmacy Technician staff, and corporate management teams

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Front End (Customer Experience)
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

As a Staff Frontend Engineer on the Customer Experience team, you will be a technical anchor for the customer-facing experiences that define how people buy a vehicle with us. You will drive frontend architecture across key parts of the purchase journey, covering trade-in, vehicle configuration, finance and leasing, and delivery, building interfaces that are fast, accessible, and crafted to earn customer trust at every step.

You will shape how the team approaches UI architecture, component systems, and frontend performance, and you will work closely with engineering, product, and design to raise the quality bar on everything the customer sees and interacts with.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Lead frontend architecture decisions across your domains, making considered choices about component design, state management, rendering strategy, and application structure that the team can build on confidently.

• Build high-quality, performant customer-facing experiences end-to-end, from UI implementation through API integration, error handling, and production monitoring.

• Own frontend performance within your domains: Core Web Vitals, rendering performance, and UI resilience when backend services or third-party integrations are degraded.

• Contribute to and help evolve the shared component library and design system, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and good developer ergonomics across customer-facing surfaces.

• Partner closely with product and design, contributing a strong technical perspective to interaction and UX decisions and flagging tradeoffs that affect performance, accessibility, or long-term maintainability.

• Drive technical initiatives within the team, authoring design docs and RFCs and establishing frontend patterns that become the default way the team builds.

• Conduct thorough code and design reviews, author architectural decision records, and help maintain a high engineering bar across the team.

• Mentor and grow senior engineers, helping them sharpen their architectural thinking, design system instincts, and ownership of the customer experience.

• Champion accessibility as a core engineering requirement throughout the development lifecycle.

• Champion pragmatic AI-assisted development, evaluating tools, contributing to team norms, and helping engineers use them effectively.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires occasional attendance in the office for in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

• Travel: Domestic travel required. Valid driver's license required.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Education/Certifications: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field

• 8+ years of frontend engineering experience, with staff-level or equivalent technical scope.

• Deep expertise in modern frontend technologies including WebGL, GSAP, Framer, and Astro, with a focus on building performant, maintainable systems.

• Strong command of React and TypeScript, including advanced patterns, performance optimization, and application architecture at scale.

• Experience contributing to or owning component libraries and design systems.

• Solid instincts for UX and interaction design, with the ability to think about the customer experience and not just the implementation.

• Strong grasp of frontend performance: Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, CSR), code splitting, and bundle optimization.

• Solid understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience building inclusive experiences in practice.

• Proven ability to lead technical work through design docs, architecture reviews, and influence within and across teams.

• Experience working closely with design and translating design intent into technically sound, maintainable implementations.

• Clear communicator, able to articulate frontend tradeoffs to product, design, and engineering stakeholders.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $165,000.00 - $200,000.00

Initial California salary range = $181,500 -$220,000

jobs.description:

Akido is the first AI-native care provider, combining cutting-edge technology with a nationwide medical network to address America’s physician shortage and make exceptional healthcare universal. Its AI empowers doctors to deliver faster, more accurate, and more compassionate care.

Serving 500K+ patients across California, Rhode Island, and New York, Akido offers primary and specialty care in 26 specialties—from serving unhoused communities in Los Angeles to ride-share drivers in New York.

Founded in 2015 (YC W15), Akido is expanding its risk-bearing care models and scaling ScopeAI, its breakthrough clinical AI platform. Read more about Akido’s $60M Series B. More info at Akidolabs.com.

The Opportunity

• The Clinical Review Nurse – Complex Case Management and Prior-Authorization is responsible for reviewing and processing prior authorization requests to ensure medical necessity, appropriate level of care, and compliance with health plan and regulatory requirements, as well as supporting complex case management for members with ongoing or high-risk care needs. This role is primarily focused on prior authorization review, with secondary responsibility for complex case management as the program grows within the Utilization Management (UM) department, and it supports delegated UM operations in a California managed care environment. The Clinical Review Nurse works closely with providers, Medical Directors, and operational teams to ensure timely and accurate authorization determinations in accordance with established clinical guidelines and delegation standards.

What you’ll do

• Review and process prior authorizations for outpatient services, procedures, diagnostic testing, specialty referrals, and DME and ancillary services

• Evaluate requests using MCG guidelines and health plan criteria and policies

• Review medical records and supporting clinical documentation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and medical necessity in accordance with established clinical guidelines and health plan requirements

• Identify missing or insufficient documentation and coordinate with providers for additional information

• Support case management for members with complex or high-risk care needs, including care coordination and follow-up

• Ensure all clinical determinations are properly documented in the system

• Maintain compliance with DMHC prior authorization requirements, CMS guidelines, health plan delegation standards, turnaround times, notification requirements, and documentation standards

• Communicate with physicians, medical groups, facilities, and ancillary providers to obtain additional clinical information and provide authorization status updates as needed

• Identify cases requiring clinical review and prepare clinical summaries for Medical Director determination

• Ensure cases requiring denial are routed appropriately to the Medical Director

• Document all authorization activities accurately within EZCap, maintaining detailed notes, status updates, and decision rationale

• Collaborate with UM Coordinators, Claims, Eligibility, and Operations

• Conduct comprehensive assessments and contribute to development of patient-centered care plans in collaboration with Medical Director

• Perform monthly care management outreach, medication review, and specialist/community resource coordination, documenting time and activities

Who you are

• Active California RN license (required)

• 3-5+ years of current clinical UM review

• Experience with prior authorization in managed care or delegated environment

• Experience with complex case management

• Knowledge of MCG criteria, medical necessity review, and prior authorization workflows

• Experience with EZCap (preferred)

• Experience in a delegated MSO or health plan environment (preferred)

• Certified Case Manager (CCM) preferred

• Knowledge of California managed care regulations (DMHC/CMS)

• Strong clinical assessment skills and attention to detail

• Effective written and verbal communication

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Salary range

$62,400—$93,600 USD

• Identify and implement opportunities to use AI tools and automation to improve the efficiency and accuracy of revenue accounting and reporting processes.

• Provide occasional support on broader operational accounting projects as needed.

• Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to improve accounting workflows, analysis, and productivity, with genuine curiosity to explore new ways of working.

Sphere Entertainment Co. is a leader in immersive experiences, technology and media. The Company includes Sphere, an experiential medium powered by advanced technologies. Who are we hiring?

The Director Health & Safety Management leads health and safety programs across development and construction projects, with a strong focus on maintaining safe, compliant, and productive active job sites. This role will serve as a hands-on safety leader in the field, partnering closely with Project Directors, construction management teams, contractors, and vendors to identify risks, establish controls, and drive continuous improvement. The Director brings strong construction safety expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence a diverse workforce while maintaining a consistent focus on accountability and operational excellence. This role will be regularly present on active construction sites and will play a critical role in ensuring safety is integrated into project planning and day-to-day execution.

What will you do?

• Lead job-site safety programs: Establish, implement, and continuously improve health and safety practices across active construction sites, ensuring alignment with company standards, project requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

• Conduct field safety oversight: Maintain a consistent presence on construction sites, conducting inspections, observations, audits, and job hazard analyses to identify unsafe conditions, behaviors, and emerging risks and ensure corrective actions are addressed promptly.

• Partner with project leadership: Work closely with Project Directors, construction managers, superintendents, contractors, and subcontractors to embed safety into project planning, scheduling, site logistics, and daily operations.

• Manage incident prevention and response: Lead investigations of incidents, near misses, and safety concerns; identify root causes; develop corrective and preventive actions; and monitor follow-through to reduce recurrence.

• Drive contractor and subcontractor accountability: Evaluate safety performance, monitor compliance with site-specific safety requirements, and hold contractors and subcontractors accountable for maintaining appropriate safety standards and practices.

• Lead training and safety communications: Develop and deliver site-specific safety training, orientations, toolbox talks, and other communications that promote awareness, reinforce expectations, and build a strong safety culture across the project workforce.

• Monitor compliance and reporting: Maintain accurate safety records, metrics, inspections, incident reports, and regulatory documentation; analyze trends and provide clear, actionable reporting to project and Development & Construction leadership.

• Champion a proactive safety culture: Serve as a visible and trusted safety leader who encourages employees and project partners to identify hazards, speak up about concerns, and take ownership of safe work practices.

• Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Health & Safety, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; relevant equivalent experience will be considered. OSHA 30-hour certification required; Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or equivalent professional certification strongly preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive health and safety experience, including significant experience supporting active construction sites and large-scale or complex projects. Experience managing safety across multiple projects or a portfolio is preferred.

• Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations and construction safety standards, as well as applicable federal, state, and local requirements and industry best practices.

• Comfortable working in an active construction environment and regularly navigating job sites, including uneven surfaces, stairs, elevated work areas, construction equipment, noise, dust, and changing site conditions. Ability to wear required PPE and comply with all site safety requirements.

• Strong ability to identify hazards, assess risk, determine appropriate controls, investigate incidents, and develop practical solutions that protect people while supporting project execution.

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to influence project leadership, contractors, subcontractors, and frontline workers without relying solely on formal authority.

• Demonstrated ability to establish clear expectations, hold project partners accountable, address unsafe behaviors or conditions decisively, and build a culture where safety is treated as a shared responsibility.

• Able to communicate safety risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, exercise sound judgment in high-pressure situations, and balance immediate project demands with long-term safety and business objectives.

Special Requirements

• This role will start remotely and will eventually be based on-site in Maryland with regular travel to business locations and other project sites.

• International travel may be required at various stages of project delivery.

• Expectation to work across international time zones which will require a flexible approach to working hours.

• Regular presence at active construction and project sites and the ability to work safely and effectively in a dynamic field environment while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Billing
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Billing team at Supabase. Billing owns the monetization and revenue systems that turn platform usage into accurate customer charges and finance-ready revenue data. The team’s scope includes plans, subscriptions, usage-based billing, invoices, payments, credits, coupons, taxation, dunning, collections, pricing mechanics, entitlements, marketplace and partner billing paths, and integrations with providers such as Stripe and Orb.

Billing sits at the intersection of engineering, product, finance, data, support, and partnerships. The systems are revenue-critical and trust-critical: they must remain correct, predictable, supportable, observable, and extensible as Supabase grows and introduces new products, pricing models, and partner channels.

This is a people, delivery, and technical leadership role. We don’t expect managers to contribute production code directly, but we do expect you to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge plans with sound technical reasoning, and set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and operational maturity.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

 - Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

 - Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

 - Coach engineers working across backend application code, data pipelines, external integrations, and operational workflows.

 - Build durable ownership across the team so critical billing knowledge, access, and incident response do not depend on one person.

 - Handle people administration, including leave and time off, for your team.

Hiring

 - Own the hiring plan for the Billing team and act as Hiring Manager and first-round interviewer for roles on the team.

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates with the right mix of billing-domain depth and engineering judgment.

 - Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery, Roadmap & Partnerships

 - Own the Billing roadmap and project management in Linear, driving accountability, clear milestones, and predictable delivery.

 - Balance new pricing and product capabilities with investments in system correctness, resilience, supportability, and technical debt.

 - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage, deciding what should be routed, prioritized, sequenced, or pushed back on.

 - Own weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating unnecessary overhead.

 - Surface risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and revenue or customer-impact concerns early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

 - Train as an Incident Commander and lead coordination, resolution, customer-impact assessment, and post-incident follow-up.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews.


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

 - Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

 - Have managed a billing engineering team at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. Experience with developer tools or databases is a strong preference, but we'll consider any sufficiently technical background where you can demonstrate the ability to ramp on a new domain.

 - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

 - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

 - Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

 - Operate as a multiplier. Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room.

 - Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

 - Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much.

 - Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early.

 - Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room.


RELEVANT BILLING DOMAIN & TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

You should bring experience across most of the following areas:

 - Subscription lifecycle and monetization mechanics: plans and packaging, billing cycles, upgrades and downgrades, proration, upfront and in-arrears charges, add-ons, credits, coupons, discounts, refunds, taxes, dunning, collections, disputes, and chargebacks.

 - Usage-based billing at scale: converting raw product and infrastructure telemetry into billable usage; defining meters and dimensions; applying quotas and pricing; handling late-arriving data; and supporting deterministic reruns, backfills, and reconciliation.

 - Payments and billing-provider integrations: production experience with Stripe, Orb, or comparable providers, including APIs, webhooks, invoice lifecycle, payment failures, event ingestion, sync engines, rate limits, provider SLAs, and graceful degradation during outages.

 - Entitlements and pricing enforcement: separating feature access from charging, managing plan defaults and customer-specific overrides, and designing auditable controls that keep product behaviour consistent with commercial agreements.

 - Cross-functional billing operations: working effectively with Finance, Data, Product, Support, Sales/RevOps, and Partnerships on revenue reporting, customer support, fraud and payment risk, marketplace billing, and new pricing launches.





WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits

jobs.title: Recruiter, GTM - AMER
jobs.description:
Chainalysis is the leader in blockchain intelligence, defining how trust is built in the digital economy. We're operating at the cutting edge of one of the world's fastest-growing industries, shaping what comes next. Over the last 2 years, Chainalysis has made big bets and moved fast to capture the market opportunity in front of us: we've accelerated growth, landed enterprise-wide contracts at the world's largest financial institutions, completed four acquisitions to build our AI talent and expand our products, and launched our first agentic product to select customers.



The Talent Acquisition team at Chainalysis is responsible for scaling the most important ingredient to our success: people. Our job is to build and execute a talent acquisition strategy that is inclusive, rigorous, and repeatable around the world. As we enter a period of significant go-to-market growth, we're investing heavily in our sales organization and need a recruiter who can match that pace.



We're looking for a Recruiter, Go-to-Market who will own and drive hiring for sales and go-to-market roles at Chainalysis. This is a high-volume, outbound-heavy role. You'll spend a meaningful portion of your time building pipeline through direct sourcing, identifying and engaging top sales talent across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services. You'll manage a full requisition load, move fast, and close strong candidates in a competitive market, with Account Executive roles among your key hires. You'll work closely with hiring managers across our enterprise and public sector sales teams, acting as a recruiting partner who understands the business and delivers results.



Please note that the position will require you to spend at least 1 day a week in our NYC Office




IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:




BUILD PIPELINE THROUGH OUTBOUND SOURCING

 - Own pipeline generation for go-to-market roles, with a heavy emphasis on proactive outbound sourcing to find and engage top sales talent

 - Map the competitive landscape across crypto, fintech, and traditional financial services to identify where strong Account Executives and quota-carrying sellers work today

 - Develop creative sourcing strategies that go beyond LinkedIn InMails, including referral generation, community engagement, and direct outreach campaigns

 - Maintain a high volume of outbound activity to keep pipeline ahead of hiring demand




RUN FULL-CYCLE RECRUITING AT PACE

 - Own the full recruiting lifecycle for go-to-market roles, from intake and sourcing through offer negotiation and close

 - Manage a high-volume requisition load across enterprise and public sector go-to-market teams

 - Move candidates through the process efficiently while delivering a thoughtful, personalized, and transparent candidate experience at every step

 - Make data-driven decisions about pipeline health, conversion rates, and sourcing channel effectiveness to keep hiring on track




PARTNER WITH HIRING MANAGERS AND THE BUSINESS

 - Build trusted relationships with sales leaders to develop a deep understanding of their teams, priorities, and what great looks like for each hire

 - Guide hiring managers through the recruiting process with clear communication, calibrated expectations, and market insights

 - Share competitive intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and hiring trends across relevant markets

 - Provide regular pipeline updates and flag risks early so hiring plans stay on schedule




CONTRIBUTE TO TALENT ACQUISITION AS A TEAM

 - Champion diversity and inclusion in every search, with intentional focus on engaging candidates from underrepresented backgrounds

 - Share sourcing wins, market learnings, and process improvements across the Talent Acquisition team

 - Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, tools, and candidate experiences

 - Occasionally provide recruiting support for roles outside of go-to-market as priorities and bandwidth allow




WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong track record of hiring sales and go-to-market talent, specifically quota-carrying roles such as Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Business Development Representatives

 - Demonstrated outbound sourcing ability: you build your own pipeline, generate candidate interest through direct outreach, and do not rely on inbound applications to fill roles

 - Proven track record of recruiting sales talent within the SaaS and Cybersecurity sectors, with a specific focus on candidates who have successfully sold complex solutions into the Fintech, Cryptocurrency, or Traditional Financial Services markets.

 - Comfort operating at high volume and managing multiple open requisitions simultaneously without dropping quality or candidate experience

 - Strong organizational skills with sharp attention to detail and consistent follow-through on every candidate and requisition

 - The ability to build credibility with hiring managers quickly, communicate market realities clearly, and guide decisions with data

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach to working on a small, close-knit Talent Acquisition team

 - Curiosity about our industry and genuine interest in learning the Chainalysis product suite and competitive landscape




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience recruiting for public sector go-to-market roles (Federal, DoD/Intel)

 - Familiarity with government clearance requirements and their impact on candidate pools

 - Experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO technology company

 - Experience working with Ashby ATS and sourcing tools

 - Recruiting experience beyond core sales roles, such as professional services, solutions engineering, or customer success



This role is ineligible for visa sponsorship.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.



About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.



You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

White Circle https://whitecircle.ai/ is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

 - We’ve recently raised our Series A funding round of $70M (total funding of $81M) from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own White Circle's content vision and editorial direction

 - Turn customer conversations into case studies, customer stories, and reference materials

 - Write and publish long-form content across Medium, Substack, LinkedIn, X, and our website

 - Develop technical and non-technical content explaining AI safety, evaluation, governance, and reliability

 - Create launch narratives for new products, features, and research initiatives

 - Partner closely with product, as well as supporting wider business teams where needed

 - Help founders maintain a consistent public voice across LinkedIn, X, conferences, and other channels

 - Build repeatable processes for content creation, publication, and distribution

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

 - Is an exceptional writer

 - Can take a complex technical topic and explain it clearly without oversimplifying it

 - Knows how to find interesting stories inside products, customers, and technology

 - Has strong editorial judgment

 - Can independently identify what is worth publishing and what isn't

 - Has experience creating content for technical audiences

 - Can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on writing

 - Is fluent in English

A big plus

 - You have an engineering, computer science, or technical background

 - You have built an audience through writing

 - You have a track record of making technical topics compelling, whether at a developer tools or AI company, in tech journalism, or through your own writing and audience

 - You've written content that materially influenced product adoption, company positioning, or revenue generation
   
   


WHY WHITE CIRCLE

 - Meaningful salary and equity package

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Fraud
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

We are the Data team within Plaid’s Fraud organization. We build the machine learning systems that power Plaid’s fraud detection products, leveraging Plaid’s network data to help identify and prevent fraud before it happens. Our team owns the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from feature pipelines and model training to production serving and monitoring, ensuring our systems are reliable, scalable, and built to support hundreds of customers and data partners.

As a Data Scientist on the Fraud Data team, you will analyze customer and network traffic to understand how Plaid Protect performs across a range of use cases and customer segments. You’ll build dashboards and metrics that provide a clear, shared view of product performance, run backtests to evaluate performance and identify high-impact rules and model strategies, and generate insights that support customer growth and expansion. You’ll also design scalable data models and schemas to enable reliable analysis and reporting, while partnering closely with Product and Engineering to design and analyze experiments for new customer-facing features.

Responsibilities:

 - Work at the intersection of product analytics, machine learning, and fraud and risk to uncover insights that improve product performance.

 - Own the metrics, dashboards, and experiments that inform product strategy and decision-making.

Qualifications:

 - 3–5 years of relevant experience, including at least 2–3 years working extensively with product analytics, experimentation, or data-driven products.

 - Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience analyzing complex datasets and translating insights into action.

 - Hands-on experience with product analytics, experimentation, and/or backtesting methodologies.

 - Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reporting frameworks, and core product metrics.

 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-Have:

 - Experience in fraud/risk domains

 - Experience with developing ML models

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

jobs.description:

Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. In this research role, you’ll partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to uncover new signals, explore and evaluate innovative modeling approaches, and translate promising research into production-ready solutions that strengthen fraud detection across Plaid’s network.

As a Senior Research Scientist, you will lead applied research to develop next-generation fraud detection models across relational graphs, sequential events, images, and video data. You’ll design rigorous experiments and evaluation methodologies that reflect real-world fraud dynamics, while exploring state-of-the-art approaches such as Graph Neural Networks and Transformer-based foundation models. In close partnership with Machine Learning Engineers, you’ll translate promising research into production-ready solutions and communicate your findings internally and externally to advance the technical bar for fraud machine learning at Plaid.

Responsibilities: 

 - Research and prototype state-of-the-art approaches across graph machine learning, sequential modeling, and multimodal learning to build next-generation fraud detection capabilities.

 - Own and execute a research roadmap that translates innovative ideas and prototypes into production solutions with measurable product and customer impact.

 - Publish and share applied research while collaborating with a highly skilled, cross-functional team across Data, Product, and Engineering.

 - Leverage Plaid’s network-level financial data to uncover insights and develop solutions that help hundreds of millions of consumers achieve greater financial freedom.

Qualifications:

 - PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field strongly preferred. Candidates without a PhD may be considered with equivalent research experience, such as significant publications, patents, or widely adopted research contributions in relevant fields.

 - 2–4+ years of relevant industry or research lab experience, ideally post-PhD, with demonstrated research leadership and a track record of translating innovative research into measurable product or business impact.

 - Demonstrated scientific rigor, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate complex research findings.

 - Strong proficiency in Python and experience building high-quality research prototypes that can inform or transition into production systems.

jobs.description:
LIFECYCLE & RETENTION MARKETING MANAGER

Location: Remote
Type: Full-time

We're a fast-growing DTC health & wellness brand looking for a Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Manager to own the customer journey across email, SMS, loyalty, and retention programs. This role sits at the center of our customer engagement strategy — you'll create personalized experiences that increase retention, repeat purchase rate, lifetime value, and brand loyalty.

We're looking for someone who's both a strategist and an operator: someone who can develop lifecycle strategy while also executing campaigns, building automations, analyzing customer behavior, and optimizing performance. You'll partner closely with Ecommerce, Paid Media, Customer Experience, and Creative to make sure customers get the right message at the right time.



What You'll Do

Email Marketing

 - Own the email marketing calendar — promotional campaigns, product launches, seasonal initiatives, and automated customer journeys

 - Build, deploy, and optimize lifecycle flows: welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, win-back, and re-engagement

 - Segment audiences to improve relevance, engagement, and revenue

 - Continuously test subject lines, creative, offers, content, timing, and targeting

 - Monitor email deliverability, list health, and subscriber engagement
   
   

SMS Marketing

 - Develop and manage the SMS program, including campaigns and automated flows

 - Ensure SMS and email work together as one cohesive lifecycle strategy

 - Grow and maintain a healthy, compliant SMS subscriber list



Loyalty & Retention

 - Own the loyalty and rewards program — strategy, execution, and ongoing optimization

 - Build initiatives that drive retention, repeat purchases, referrals, and LTV

 - Create lifecycle campaigns tied to loyalty milestones, rewards, VIP tiers, birthdays, and anniversaries

 - Monitor loyalty performance and recommend enhancements based on customer behavior and results

 - Partner with Customer Experience and Ecommerce to create a seamless loyalty experience



AIO/SEO Optimization

 - Optimize product, collection, and content pages for both traditional SEO and AI-driven search/discovery

 - Monitor how the site and products surface in search engines and AI tools (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity), adjusting content and structure accordingly

 - Keep site structure, metadata, and content optimized for crawlability and machine-readable answers

 - Collaborate with content and paid ads teams to align organic and paid search strategies



Customer Lifecycle Strategy

 - Develop and optimize end-to-end customer journeys from first purchase through long-term loyalty

 - Identify customer segments and lifecycle opportunities using behavioral and transactional data

 - Build personalized lifecycle programs based on customer needs, interests, and purchase history

 - Create strategies to reduce churn and increase engagement

 - Partner with acquisition teams for a seamless prospect-to-customer transition



Who You Are

 - Passionate about health and wellness, motivated by helping people live healthier lives

 - Driven by metrics and growth, with a constant curiosity to improve performance

 - Comfortable moving fast in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

 - Deeply curious about consumer decision-making and how small details shape the user journey

 - A self-starter who stays on top of digital marketing and AI/search trends



Qualifications

 - 3+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, e-commerce, or digital marketing, with hands-on Shopify experience required

 - Direct experience running email marketing flows — Klaviyo experience preferred

 - Direct experience running e-commerce loyalty programming

 - Ability to balance hands-on execution with big-picture strategic thinking

 - Strong attention to detail and a proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem-solving

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally (especially with the Paid Ads Manager and broader marketing team)

 - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience



Technical Skills

 - Comfortable working across both the front-end and back-end of a website

 - Deep understanding of the Shopify ecosystem, including apps and integrations

 - At ease in email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo), both designing and executing campaigns, plus experience with SMS marketing tools

 - Comfortable with numbers, analytics, and attribution modeling to inform decisions

 - Strong grasp of the technical back-end, paired with an obsession for front-end polish and brand alignment

 - Experience building landing pages for paid advertising campaigns

What we're looking for

About the Role

As a Store Manager, you’ll be responsible for the total holistic omni customer experience in your store, ensuring high visual and commercial curation & standards according to the store format location and global & regional strategies. You have the responsibility of leading the full store team to excel. You create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit and are responsible & aware of the store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. You’ll also be the person who analyzes and follows up on sales, creating plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to your store format environment, global guidelines and regional strategies
• Represent yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Establish, analyze, and follow up on sales & budget goals, and create plans to optimize results
• Ensure personal customer service is provided in all areas of the store, ensuring your team initiates customer interactions, guiding customers through fashion stories and works towards actively selling our products

• Be aware of your store strengths and opportunities, identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them. Maintain competitor awareness & knowledge

• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Ensure good understanding of the local area of your store, customers, competition, and fashion trends

Team & Development

• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business needs & team
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Strong collaboration with Area team and store leadership team including VMs
• Ensure excellent communication & professionalism
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

Who You Are

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
ABOUT GIGA

Giga has recently raised a $61M Series A and is working with Fortune 500 customers to deploy the next generation of customer experience - real-time AI agents that can understand emotion, resolve issues instantly, and scale across the world's largest enterprises.

Industry leaders like DoorDash trust Giga with their most complex support and operations workflows across voice, chat, and email, in high-stakes regulated environments where accuracy and compliance matter. We're at an exciting inflection point.

While we've found real commercial success, our ambitions are larger: to become the go-to AI platform for all enterprise automation, powered by our voice superintelligence. The work affects millions of people every day, and our team has the autonomy to make true impact - with brilliant founders, a clear path forward, and the kind of momentum that defines generational companies.

If being part of that resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you!

 - Voice AI startup Giga raises $61M Series A https://fortune.com/2025/11/05/voice-ai-giga-raise-61-million-customer-service-series-a/

 - DoorDash and Giga Partnership https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7391576181009018883/




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own consumption across a book of roughly 10 of Giga's production customers. Every enterprise contract we sign carries a minimum usage commitment. Your job is to get each customer to that commitment and past it: more conversations on the agent, more intents live, more channels and business units on Giga. You carry a number for it. You'll own each customer's timeline for getting there, and you'll push on it from both sides: externally, when the customer's team is slow to expand scope or route volume, and internally, when a product bug or a missing capability is what's holding them back. You sit between our Forward Deployed Engineers, who build and tune the agents, and our Enterprise Sales Representatives, who close the deals. You're the quarterback in the middle.

This is the first hire in a function we intend to build. You report to the CEO, you'll work directly with the founders and the revenue leadership team, and you'll define how customer success works at Giga before anyone else joins it.

This is not an FDE role and it's not a renewals desk. You won't be digging through tickets to find the root cause; the FDEs do that. You will know that something needs fixing, what it's costing the customer, and when it has to be done, and you'll drive it there. You'll also be the one telling customers what we're shipping and where the next use case is. When that turns into a real deal, the Enterprise Sales Representative comes back in to run it with you. You own usage and the timeline, they own paper.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

A few examples from our current roadmap:

 - Consumption plans for every account in the book: Build the per-account plan from go-live to the annual minimum and beyond: which intents and channels go live in which month, what volume each one carries, and what has to be true on the customer's side and ours for each date to hold. Track it weekly and act when a week goes flat.

 - Quarterbacking the timeline, both directions: Externally, keep the customer's team moving on scope expansion, volume routing, and the approvals that slow them down. Internally, when a product bug or a missing capability is blocking a customer's next step, get it prioritized with FDEs and Product, hold the date, and tell the customer the truth about it. You don't investigate the ticket. You make sure it gets fixed on time.

 - Escalations at the right altitude: When something breaks in production, you're the customer's single point of contact. You know what's broken and what it's costing them, you pull in the right FDE, you own the communication up to the customer's executive, and you stay on it until volume is back.

 - Evangelizing what's next: Pitch customers on what we're shipping and where the next use case is in their operation. Mine conversation data, Agent KPIs, and their queue metrics to find it, quantify the savings, and get their operating leader interested. When it turns into a real opportunity, bring the Enterprise Sales Representative back in and run it together.

 - Executive cadence: Run monthly value reviews and quarterly business reviews with the customer's VP or SVP of Customer Care, Operations, or CX, with our CEO and founders in the room when it matters. The output is a bigger volume plan with dates on it, not a satisfaction score.

 - Making consumption visible: Work with RevOps to get usage against commit, and the blockers behind it, in front of the whole revenue org in Salesforce every week.

As the first Customer Success hire at Giga, you'll be expected to build the playbook, not inherit one, and to show the CEO what the function should look like at 30 customers.




HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

You own a book of roughly 10 production customers and you're paid on two things: every customer in it reaching full value on their commitment, and the book growing past it.

 - Gross revenue retention. Every customer in your book consumes their full contracted commitment and renews at or above it. This is the floor, and it's most of the variable.

 - Net revenue retention. Usage above commit, new intents, new channels, new lines of business. You find it, quantify it with the customer, and hand a qualified opportunity to the Enterprise Sales Representative to close. They carry the quota credit, you get NRR credit when it lands.

 - Leading indicators we watch with you: time from production go-live to run-rate consumption, weekly usage against the ramp plan, and executive engagement on each account.

Compensation is $200,000 to $250,000 on-target earnings depending on experience, split 75% base and 25% variable, plus equity. Variable is paid quarterly, weighted 70% gross revenue retention and 30% net revenue retention across your book, with accelerators above target.

Here's how the number works. Every account in your book has an annual minimum commitment. We divide it into quarterly expected usage, adjusted for the ramp we agreed with the customer at signing, and those quarterly numbers add up to your book target. The GRR component pays on actual usage against that target and on renewals at or above commit. The NRR component pays on usage above commit and on expansion closed in your book, whether or not you sourced it. The Enterprise Sales Representative carries the quota credit on expansion; you earn the NRR credit when it lands.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years in customer success, technical account management, or account management at a company priced on usage or consumption (API platform, CCaaS, cloud data, AI platform), and have personally carried a consumption, NRR, or utilization number.

 - Have taken a customer from go-live to full value on a commit, and past it, and can walk us through it: the number, where it stalled, what you did, what it ended at.

 - Read usage data yourself. You build the burn-down, you spot the flat week, and you know why before anyone asks. SQL or serious spreadsheet fluency.

 - Speak contact center. Containment, resolution rate, CSAT, AHT, transfer rate, QA scoring. You understand how a VP of Customer Care decides to route more volume to an AI agent, and what makes them stop.

 - Can run an executive relationship at a Fortune 1000 (VP or SVP of CX, Operations, or a COO) and a working relationship with their ops and IT teams in the same week.

 - Have quarterbacked a cross-functional timeline before: a customer expansion, a migration, a launch, where half the blockers were on your side of the house. You pushed engineers and product on dates without doing their jobs, and you told the customer the truth when a date moved.

 - Are comfortable in the seam between engineers and sellers. You've run production escalations with an unhappy customer on one side and an engineer on the other, and kept both. You know the difference between knowing what needs fixing and fixing it, and you stay on your side of that line.

 - Would rather ship a ramp plan this week than perfect a QBR deck. High tolerance for ambiguity, low need for process handed to you.

 - Use AI tools every day and have worked hands-on with AI agents (voice or chat) in production. You can read a conversation log and tell the FDE what the customer is experiencing, even if you don't know why yet.

Nice to Have

 - Came from a company that pays customer success on consumption (Snowflake, Databricks, Twilio, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar).

 - Have sold or expanded conversational AI, CCaaS, or contact center automation into insurance, financial services, airlines, retail, or restaurants.

 - Have run value reviews that quantified savings and turned directly into a larger commitment.

Perks & Benefits

 - $200K to $250K OTE (75% base / 25% variable) + equity

 - Catered lunch daily

 - Dinner stipend

 - $500/month wellness & commuter benefit (commute, gym, fitness classes, mental health)

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. These innovations in pathology can help accelerate drug development, improve confidence in the accuracy of diagnosis, and get life-saving therapies to patients more quickly. At PathAI, you'll work with a diverse and talented team of people, who are dedicated to solving complex problems and making a huge impact.

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Engineering team. In this position, you will help build and maintain the automated testing infrastructure that underpins the reliability of PathAI's software platform. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and QA leads to design test strategies, write automation code, review pull requests, and debug complex failures — all in service of delivering software that clinicians and patients can depend on.

In addition, you will actively contribute to expanding and optimizing our testing infrastructure. As PathAI's platform grows, so does the complexity of our testing needs — you will help scale our automation capabilities by contributing to test environments, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment pipelines that keep quality high across multiple services and teams. This includes hands-on work with AWS and Kubernetes to provision, manage, and observe test environments, and a focus on making our toolset faster, more reliable, and easier for the whole engineering team to use.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their SDET career who is eager to learn, grow quickly, and make a real impact in healthcare technology.

The Opportunity

• You will design, implement, and maintain automated test suites using modern automation frameworks across UI, API, and integration layers.

• You will participate actively in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback to raise the overall quality bar.

• You will work with engineers and business stakeholders to understand new features and translate requirements into comprehensive test plans.

• You will perform manual testing as needed to support product verification and user acceptance testing.

• You will investigate and debug test failures, production incidents, and flaky tests; communicate findings clearly to the broader team.

• You will contribute to CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated tests run reliably on every build.

• You will help build and maintain the cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes) that supports test environments and scales our test toolset across the platform.

• You will document test strategies, coverage gaps, and known issues in a clear and accessible way.

• You will collaborate cross-functionally with a remote-friendly, distributed team, managing your own priorities and deliverables independently.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or closely related field.

• You have 1–2 years of hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar.

• You have a demonstrated level of proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, TypeScript, or equivalent) with clean, readable coding habits.

• You have a demonstrated ability to perform and benefit from code reviews — both giving actionable feedback and incorporating it constructively.

• You have demonstrated debugging skills: ability to isolate root causes across multiple layers of a system (frontend, backend, infrastructure, data).

• You have demonstrated working knowledge of AWS (e.g., EC2, S3, ECS, Lambda) and experience working in or alongside containerized environments.

• You have a solid level of familiarity with Kubernetes for deploying, managing, or observing services in test or staging environments.

• You have demonstrated experience working in a team environment with excellent written and verbal communication skills; you are comfortable asking clarifying questions and surfacing blockers

Preferred:

• You have a background in healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industry software development.

• You have experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, CircleCI, or similar).

• You have exposure to performance, load, or security testing practices.

• You have a genuine desire to learn — you seek out feedback, read documentation thoroughly, and adapt to new tools and processes quickly.

• You have strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail; you have the ability to manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast-paced environment

This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA.
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

jobs.title: Pizza Maker (01740) - 2931 7th Ave #100
jobs.description:
Customer Service Representative

It all starts with you

Domino's Pizza loves Domino's people. Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential. In other words, we want you to be yourself, and as a Domino's Customer Service Rep that's exactly what you can be. Our Team Members know their stuff and know how to have a good time. Each store has its own personality, and we reward outstanding pizza making or up selling.

Drive your own career

Being a Domino's Customer Service Rep isn't your average pizza gig. And the way Domino's works, it could be just the beginning. Many of our team members began their careers as CSRs and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service to management, general manager to franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

You'll find our Customer Service Representative jobs offer you more. From the first slice of pizza to the last customer you serve, we know how important it is to provide the best training and support. Our people are the reason we're successful today, and why we'll continue to be successful in the future. So it makes sense for us to help you become your very best. We don't drop you in the deep end. Your Domino's Manager or teammate will show you the ropes in-store, so you can hit the ground running without any worries.

Domino's CSR Responsibilities Include: :

· Demonstrating a friendly, positive attitude and great customer service skills

· Taking orders over the phone and in person

· Dealing with customer concerns

· Cash handling

· Upselling

· Making Domino’s high quality pizzas

· Food and portion control

· Hygiene and food safety

· Food preparation

· General cleaning duties

Those are the basics, but here’s what else you can expect:

General Job Duties

· Operate all equipment

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler

· Prepare product

· Receive and process telephone orders

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator)

· Must be able to make correct monetary change

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders

· Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen

Work Conditions

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside

· Fumes from food odors

· Exposure to cornmeal dust

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts

Sensing

· Talking and hearing on telephone

· Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks

· Depth perception

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces

Temperaments

· The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions

Physical Requirements including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

· Most tasks are performed from a standing position

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72high

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store

· Trays of pizza dough are carried over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push

· Trays may also be pulled

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients

Crouching/Squatting

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Ops
jobs.description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology.

PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. At PathAI, you'll work with a diverse and talented team of people, who are dedicated to solving complex problems and making a huge impact.

• You will architect and build infrastructure and automation, in AWS and on-premises, to support ML application development and deployment

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have strong software engineering skills in complex, multi-language systems and experience with scalable backend architecture.

• You have experience with Kubernetes and cloud computing platforms (AWS preferred).

• You have a solid understanding of DevOps principles and infrastructure-as-code (Helm, Terraform).
