jobs.title: EHS Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

As an Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Manager your primary emphasis will be to lead a diverse team in an operational setting promoting a culture of safety, sustainability and environmental responsibility.  You will be responsible for developing and implementing industrial safety, laboratory safety, industrial hygiene, and environmental programs, managing regulatory compliance and fostering a safe and environmentally conscious work environment.

You will manage a cross functional EHS team in a growing environment covering several phases, such as research and development, manufacturing, construction, and operations.  You and your team are responsible for the overall health and safety of the facility.

A successful candidate will need to be highly collaborative, have a lean business mindset, be able to find pioneering ways to achieve complex objectives, adaptable to a fast moving environment, be able to prioritize objectives, and align with the company’s goals and risk tolerance.

Responsibilities

• Lead a diverse team of EHS professionals, while providing mentorship and growth opportunities.

• Develop, implement and maintain environmental, health and safety programs to ensure compliance with local, state and federal regulations.

• Partner with operations, maintenance, laboratory, construction, and research staff to ensure proper identification and mitigation of hazards to ensure work gets done safely.

• Drive the Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) process to improve the overall safety of operations.

• Strategize and implement plans to reduce incident rates and improve EHS performance.

• Implement emergency response plans for incidents and ensure employees are trained accordingly.

• Develops, reviews and conducts EHS-related training, including safety orientation, as part of the new hire orientation meetings.

• Promote a culture of environmental responsibility and encourage sustainable practices throughout the organization.

• Stay current with all environmental, health and safety regulations, inspections and standards and ensure the organization's adherence to all applicable laws.

• Prepare, maintain and submit regulatory reports, permits and documentation as required.

• Conduct workplace inspections and audits to monitor compliance and to identify areas for improvement.

• Oversee hazardous material program including inventory, disposal, recycling, and handling.

• Partner and manage relationships with vendors to assist with the environment, health and safety of the facility.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, management and external agencies to ensure alignment with safety goals.

• Ensure that EHS is providing opportunities for direct and honest communication including leading safety committee meetings, toolbox talks, lunch and learns, safety moments, etc.

• Maintains regular engagement with employees and operational areas to understand workflow and operational processes, identify emerging risks and support EHS solutions.

• Investigate all incidents and accidents, determining root causes and implementing corrective and preventive measures.

• Maintain incident records and report findings to upper management and regulatory authorities as required through the First Report of Incident process.

• Collect, analyze and report data related to safety performance.

• Identify trends and opportunities for improvement based on data analysis.

• Drive results through the Objectives and Key Results (OKR) process, while leveraging partnerships with key contributors.

• Be a first responder and part of Emergency Response Team.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, or a related field.

• 5+ years of management of EHS programs focusing on safety management, regulatory compliance, risk management, and program development.

• 5+ years of direct management experience.

• Must have expertise in a discipline within EHS, certification is preferred.

• Proven track record in working with others to accomplish objectives.

• Proven track record of developing a strong safety culture and reducing recordable incident rates.

• Professional certification relevant to EHS, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CHI), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), or another relevant credential is preferred but not required.

• Experience supporting EHS activities across multiple operating environments, such as research and development, laboratories, manufacturing, construction, and facility operations is preferred but not required.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• In-depth understanding of local, state and federal EH&S regulations applicable to the industry.

• Knowledge of recognized hazard-identification, risk-assessment and control methodologies, including Job Hazard Analysis and the hierarchy of controls.

• Knowledge of incident-investigation and root-cause-analysis principles and corrective-action practices.

• Ability to develop, implement, evaluate, and continuously improve EHS programs, procedures and management systems.

• Ability to assess complex or changing work processes and recommend practical, risk-based EHS controls.

• Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and communicate their operational implications to employees and management.

• Ability to analyze EHS data and performance metrics, identify trends and develop appropriate improvement strategies.

• Ability to lead, coach and develop EHS professionals and establish clear priorities and accountability.

• Ability to build collaborative working relationships across operational, technical, research, maintenance, construction, and management functions.

• Ability to influence decisions and promote safe work practices without relying solely on direct authority.

• Ability to communicate technical EHS information clearly through written procedures, reports, presentations, training, and employee engagement.

• Ability to manage multiple EHS priorities in a dynamic R&D and operational environment, while applying sound judgment to risk-based decisions.

• Ability to lead or support emergency preparedness and response activities within the scope of assigned training and responsibilities.

• Ability to engage employees at all organizational levels and encourage reporting, participation and continuous improvement in EHS programs.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Capability to conduct thorough incident investigations and risk assessments.

• Strong knowledge of EHS regulations, codes and standards.

• Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.

• Prioritizes and ensures safety of oneself and others.

• Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge.

• Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges and issues.

Physical Demands

• Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, scissor lifts, articulated boom lifts, etc..

• Setting up and transferring temporary structures (e.g. scaffolding, ladders).

• Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments, including tight and confined spaces.

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another.

• Adjusting, moving, transporting, installing, positioning, or removing objects up to 35 pounds in all directions.

Environmental Conditions

• General office environment.

• Low temperatures.

• High temperatures.

• Outdoor environment or elements, such as precipitation and wind.

• Noisy environments.

• Small and/or enclosed spaces.

• Odors or fumes from chemicals or chemical reactions.

• Elevated heights.

Safety and PPE

• Manipulating, cleaning and disposal of hazardous materials.

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions.

• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, etc..

• Handling of Beryllium (Be) containing material.

Travel

• Some travel may be required, up to 10%.

Certification

• Professional certification relevant to EHS, such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CHI), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), or another relevant credential is preferred but not required.

Additional Requirements

• Seldom requires working weekends.

• Occasionally requires schedule flexibility.

• Seldom requires non-standard work-week hours.

• Seldom requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines.

• Onsite: #LI-Onsite

About our Benefits

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

• Competitive compensation packages

• Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents

• Paid Vacation

• 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools

As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things:

• The analytics layer: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them

• Reporting and BI: the reporting layer the whole business reads from

• Our production systems: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity

• The partnership with our engineering team: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly

This is a build-and-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health.

Location: New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer

• Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure

• Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook

• Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas

Take Ownership of What's in Production

• Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy

• Be accountable for uptime & system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting.

• Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime

• Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it

Partner Across the Business

• Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them

• Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking

• Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds

What Success Looks Like

• Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them

• Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly

• Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth

• Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped

• Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health

About You

You bring:

• Fluency in dbt and Python

• Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7

• A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec

• Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks

• Bachelor's degree required

• A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You'll stand out if you:

• Want to own a system deeply: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build

• Get to root cause: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom

• Are AI-native: you live in modern AI tools to support your work

• Communicate with clarity: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively

• Own the outcome: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased

Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

• $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

• Generous annual performance bonus

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• 401(k) with company match

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.

The role

As a Staff ML Engineer, you own a major subsystem of a novel exploitability engine end to end—for example the probability core, the exposure graph and entity-resolution layer, or the calibration and validation loop. You make the design calls within your area and drive them to production.

What you’ll own

• A major subsystem end-to-end—the probability core, the exposure graph and entity resolution, or the calibration and validation loop—including its design, delivery, and quality.
• The design decisions within your subsystem, and how it interfaces with the rest of the engine.
• The metrics that prove your subsystem works—entity-resolution accuracy, calibration quality, or path-ranking precision—owned as first-class targets.
• Technical direction for the engineers working in your area.

What you’ll do

• Take a major, ambiguous subsystem from design through production at scale.
• Drive design and code reviews in your area, and raise the engineering bar around you.
• Mentor engineers and lead a workstream through influence.
• Partner with product, security R&D, and SecOps to turn customer problems into subsystem design.

What you bring

• A track record of owning a significant system or subsystem end-to-end in production.
• Hands-on depth in agentic and LLM systems and/or probabilistic or ML-driven scoring—graph modeling, calibration, search and optimization.

About the team

The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.

This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.

What you’ll own

• The end-to-end architecture of the exploitability engine—from evidence ingestion and entity resolution, through the attack-path probability core and choke-point ranking, to the validation loop that keeps predictions honest.

• The probabilistic ranking core: edge-traversal probability, guided path search with hop and likelihood limits, correlated-control-failure modeling, and honest uncertainty bands.
• The calibration and validation loop—canaries, purple-team and incident replay, calibration measured by zone and vector—that turns modeled weights into evidence rather than opinion.

jobs.title: Staff Industrial Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power Electronics is a company building cutting-edge power electronics products for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the sustainable electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads like datacenters to the grid. Heron Power's leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products.

We believe great design is an important part of building great technology. Our products are physical machines, digital interfaces, tools, environments, documentation, and a brand—and the experience of Heron is shaped by all of them.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We learn together, build together, and solve difficult problems from first principles. You can expect to work in a fast-moving, deeply technical environment where designers work directly with engineers, operators, customers, and leadership to turn complex technology into products and experiences that are clear, useful, thoughtful, and distinctly Heron.




JOB OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Staff Industrial Designer to help shape the products, experiences, and visual language of Heron Power Electronics.

This is a broad design role with industrial design at its center, spanning physical product design, product UX, visual communication, and brand. You might spend one project developing the form, architecture, interfaces, and details of a new power electronics product; another improving how an operator interacts with a product; and another creating the creating graphics, infographics, environmental elements, or documentation that make complex ideas clear.

You will work closely with the Head of Design and leadership across mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, manufacturing, software, commercial, and more. You'll move fluidly between defining a problem, exploring concepts, prototyping solutions, developing production-ready designs, and working with partners to bring them into the world.

As a Staff-level designer, you will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of ambiguous design problems, establish a strong point of view, move quickly from thinking to making, and help raise the quality and coherence of design across Heron.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

 - Drive industrial design efforts across Heron's power electronics products, from early architecture and concept development through detailed design and production.

 - Work directly with mechanical, electrical, thermal, manufacturing, and systems engineers to understand technical constraints and turn them into thoughtful product solutions.

 - Explore product architecture, proportion, form, materials, finishes, interfaces, serviceability, manufacturing processes, and details.

 - Build quickly and think through making—using sketches, CAD, physical prototypes, renderings, mockups, animations, and whatever tools best address the question at hand.

 - Help define how people physically interact with Heron products, including installation, operation, service, access, controls, labeling, status communication, and safety.

 - Contribute to digital product UX where physical and digital experiences intersect, working with software teams to make complex systems understandable and intuitive.

 - Develop clear visual communication for complex technical ideas through diagrams, information graphics, presentations, product graphics, documentation, and other storytelling tools.

 - Extend and evolve Heron's visual identity across products, spaces, digital experiences, events, and communications.

 - Establish design systems, principles, and patterns that create consistency across an expanding family of Heron products and touchpoints.

 - Advocate for the user while balancing engineering performance, manufacturing, cost, reliability, safety, serviceability, and business requirements.

 - Raise the design bar across the company through strong craft, thoughtful critique, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details and go the extra mile.
   
   


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We're looking for an Industrial Designer with deep industrial design capability and unusually broad range.

You do not need to be equally specialized in every design discipline. We care more about excellent design judgment, strong execution, curiosity, and the ability to move confidently across different kinds of problems.




MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - Significant professional experience designing and shipping physical products, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional industrial design thinking and craft, strong taste, breadth across disciplines, and the ability to carry ideas from early exploration through polished execution.

 - Strong industrial design fundamentals, including form development, proportion, product architecture, CMF, ergonomics, manufacturing processes, and design detailing.

 - Strong 3D skills and experience developing concepts through CAD, rendering, prototyping, and physical models.

 - Heart. We are rebuilding the American grid. Solving extremely difficult and urgent problems. Laying the foundation for highly intelligent power infrastructure that can enable abundant, efficient, sustainable energy. This is a BFD. It should move you.

 - Experience collaborating closely with engineering teams and working within real technical, manufacturing, cost, and schedule constraints.

 - Strong graphic and visual communication skills, including layout, composition, typography, information hierarchy, diagrams, and presentation design.

 - Experience thinking about products as complete experiences—not just objects—including physical interaction, interfaces, installation, service, communication, and environment.

 - Ability to independently frame ambiguous problems, develop a point of view, communicate design rationale, and drive work forward with limited direction.

 - Low ego, high curiosity, strong internal drive, and sincere enthusiasm for collaborating with people from disciplines very different from your own.

 - Experience designing industrial equipment, energy products, robotics, vehicles, electronics, or other technically complex physical products.

 - Experience with UX or interaction design for hardware, embedded interfaces, tools, dashboards, or technical systems.

 - Experience developing or evolving visual identities and applying brand systems across physical and digital touchpoints.

 - Experience with product graphics, labeling, wayfinding, environmental graphics, or tradeshow/exhibition design.

 - Experience working in a startup or other environment where designers need to do it all, big and small, and move comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.

 - An interest in electricity, energy systems, manufacturing, and the physical infrastructure that makes modern life possible.

If you're a designer who gets excited moving between the scale of a machine, an interface, a diagram, and a brand—and wants to do it side by side with exceptional engineers solving genuinely hard problems—we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer - Structures & Systems
jobs.description:
Embark on a journey with QDSS at the forefront of technological innovation as we seek talented Engineers to shape the future of cutting-edge projects and contribute to a culture of excellence and creativity.  What we do matters.

Quest Defense Systems & Solutions is seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the integration of aircraft structures and systems across the product lifecycle. This position will serve as a technical focal point for design architecture, interfaces, manufacturing integration, certification, and engineering change management.

• Location: Remote; Eastern or Central time zone preferred

• Preferred Proximity: Cincinnati, Ohio, or Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas

• Travel: Less than 25%

• Citizenship Requirement: Must qualify as a U.S. Person

• Security Clearance: Not required at the time of hire; ability to obtain a clearance in the future is preferred

What You Will Do:

• Lead conceptual layouts and integration solutions for aircraft structures and systems.

• Design primary and secondary structures, systems installations, and antenna installations for advanced connectivity systems.

• Define system architecture, interfaces, installation requirements, and Interface Control Drawings.

• Prepare structural and systems layouts, installation drawings, and detailed engineering drawings.

• Perform trade studies to optimize weight, cost, performance, and manufacturability.

• Develop and process Program Change Requests and manage modifications through configuration control.

• Evaluate the technical, cost, schedule, risk, and profitability impacts of proposed changes.

• Coordinate technical integration across Stress, Systems, Interiors, Aerodynamics, Mass Properties, Manufacturing, Quality, and Certification.

• Lead technical meetings with customers and suppliers and ensure the delivery of quality engineering documentation.

• Chair or support design reviews, risk assessments, and program milestone gates.

• Support manufacturing, production, and shop-floor issue resolution.

• Apply Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly principles.

• Support verification, validation, testing, qualification, and certification activities.

• Maintain accurate product lifecycle management and configuration data.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• At least 5 years of aerospace engineering experience involving aircraft structures or systems integration.

• Experience designing primary and secondary airframe structures and systems installations.

• Proficiency with CATIA V5 or Siemens NX.

• Experience developing layouts, installation drawings, interface drawings, and detailed designs.

• Knowledge of materials and processes, GD&T, aerospace design standards, and preliminary sizing.

• Understanding of aircraft systems, structural interfaces, manufacturing processes, and industrialization.

• Knowledge of CAR, FAR, or CS certification requirements and compliance processes.

• Experience with configuration management and PLM systems such as ENOVIA or Teamcenter.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Must qualify as a U.S. Person under applicable export-control regulations.

Desired Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• At least 15 years of relevant aerospace engineering experience.

• Experience with antenna or aircraft connectivity-system installations.

• Knowledge of aircraft interiors integration and in-service maintenance constraints.

• French-language proficiency.

• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance in the future.

• Experience in the adoption and/or integration of emerging technologies (e.g., generative AI, automation platforms, digital assistants) into day-to-day operations for continuous improvement.

The QDSS Advantage:

At QDSS, our advantage is purpose-driven work, collaborative teams, and complex challenges that push boundaries and build lasting impact. You’ll grow your career while contributing to mission-critical programs that demand excellence and shape the future.

What You’ll Find Here

• Work That Matters – Next-generation, safety- and mission-critical projects where your contributions have real-world impact.

• Growth That’s Supported – Competitive compensation, employer-matched 401(k), certification assistance, and clear opportunities for advancement.

• A Culture That Works – A flexible, collaborative, and people-first environment where teamwork, innovation, and balance are valued.

Benefits Include

• Competitive pay, comprehensive medical/dental/life and disability coverage, 401(k) with employer match, professional development support, and a flexible, friendly workplace.

Full compensation package is based on candidate experience and certifications

Pay Ranges

$130,000—$145,000 USD

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. HR Operations & Compliance

Process Improvement & Automation

• Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
• Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).
• Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and platforms (required).
• Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
• Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).

• Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
• Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
• Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Preferred: recruitment or sourcing experience, including candidate outreach, vetting, and interviewing.
• Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

• Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

• Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
• Paid time off, including U.S. federal holidays, sick leave, and annual leave.
• Pacific Time-aligned working hours with reasonable flexibility.

Responsible for delivering a highly satisfied customer experience proven by engaging and interacting with all customers, embodying customer experience principles and philosophy, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. • Capable of multi-tasking

• Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, Storage – AI Cloud
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

AI Cloud Data Storage

NVIDIA DGXC Storage org handles some of the fastest training and inference tasks. Every GPU cycle depends on a storage platform built to keep tens of thousands of accelerators continuously busy. It maintains exabytes of data securely and powers the largest AI workloads worldwide across cloud, neocloud, and on-prem setups. With the growth of accelerated computing, storage is essential. It can make the difference between effective GPU use and wasted potential and between launching a frontier model on time or missing the deadline by months. We seek a Distinguished Engineer to lead NVIDIA's storage strategy for AI Cloud across the Neocloud Provider (NCP) and Cloud Service Provider (CSP) ecosystem. You will direct the architecture of high-performance parallel file systems, object stores, and block storage at exabyte scale. You will stay hands-on, collaborating with engineers, SREs, partners, and storage vendors. You will apply NVIDIA's AI tools to increase your productivity and that of those you impact. This is a distinctive prospect to establish the storage framework of the AI era at the company that introduced accelerated computing.

What you'll be doing:

• Lead the multi-year technical plan for AI Cloud Storage expansion across NCPs — determine the reference architecture, capabilities, performance and durability SLOs, qualification methodology, and roadmap for the high-performance file, object, and block storage that each NCP must offer to qualify for NVIDIA GPU allocation.
• Serve as the chief storage architect with deep hands-on involvement. Lead key reviews of storage builds and investigate root causes of complex production problems. Develop prototype reference implementations to minimize risks in new initiatives. Make final technical decisions on NCP storage deliveries using measurable SLOs. Apply AI tools heavily to amplify your technical influence throughout the program.
• Define the standard for "production-ready" in NCP storage, including durability and availability SLOs measured in 9s. Ensure sustained efficiency per TiB, observability, blast-radius containment, and reduced operational toil. Influence GPU delivery gating by requiring AI Cloud to accept GPU capacity only after verifying storage-focused ancillary services.
• Develop and guide the architectural direction by working closely with collaborators in training, inference, and accelerated-computing product lines. Coordinate with site-reliability, operations, networking, and security colleagues. Work together with external cloud providers, neocloud operators, and storage vendors to align on a common architecture.
• Develop the open-source path forward for AI storage. Establish and guide an open-source strategy that broadens the AI storage ecosystem. Advocate for a GitHub-first, security-first stance. Engage deeply with upstream open-source communities. Formalize the APIs, SDKs, and protocols allowing partners and the industry to build, integrate, and create with NVIDIA at the AI storage level.
• Lead an engineering culture centered on AI tools. Regularly use modern AI coding and agentic tools in your daily tasks. Show what 10× engineering means at NVIDIA. Distribute patterns, prompts, and evaluation harnesses across the storage organization.
• Partner with peer Distinguished and Principal storage architects across the organization to tackle the most difficult, long-term technical challenges. Make automation the only acceptable solution for infrastructure management tasks like live software upgrades, node and drive replacements, capacity rebalancing, cross-DC data movement, and dataset lifecycle. Establish root-cause analysis and corrective action rigor on every major incident. Design the storage layer for workloads spanning the next several GPU generations, including disaggregated inference with storage-backed KV caching, large-scale write-once-read-many inference patterns, exabyte regional object stores, and cross-DC dataset versioning and copy management.
• Mentor and develop senior, principal, and distinguished engineers across the storage organization and nearby business units. Raise the technical bar broadly. Represent NVIDIA externally in standards bodies, open-source communities, customer briefings, and industry forums (FAST, SC, OCP, SNIA, Linux Storage Summit).

What we need to see:

• BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
• A minimum of 18+ years of practical engineering experience in storage technology is needed. This involves extensive involvement with a high-performance parallel file system like Lustre, GPFS / Spectrum Scale, WEKA, VAST, BeeGFS, DAOS, or its equivalent, handling data at multi-petabyte scale. Candidates must also have wide-ranging expertise in object storage (S3 / Swift-class) and block storage (NVMe-oF, NVMesh-class, iSCSI).
• A track record of crafting and managing storage platforms at exabyte scale for performance-critical workloads — AI training, HPC, video, or hyperscale data lakes — including direct responsibility for durability, availability, and performance SLOs measured in 9s.
• Demonstrated ability to set technical strategy across business units and partner organizations. You have driven multi-year storage architectures adopted by multiple teams, vendors, or customers. You can point to measurable outcomes such as GPU utility lift, $/PB reduction, incidents eliminated, and time-to-bring-up compressed.
• You are 100% hands-on in engineering. You write and review production code yourself. When a bug requires it, you read Lustre, NFS, kernel, NVMe-oF, or SPDK source code. You also run scale tests or recovery drills personally instead of delegating.
• Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (C, C++, Rust, or Go) and proficiency in Python; comfortable in the Linux kernel storage and networking stacks (block layer, RDMA / RoCE / InfiniBand, NVMe, page cache, VFS, multipath).
• Frequent daily use of advanced AI coding and autonomous tools, including specific examples showing how you accelerated building, coding, debugging, validation, and operations. Also, share your perspective on future trends.
• Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a one-pager that aligns a VP. You can also write a six-pager that aligns an entire org. You can explain a deep technical trade-off to an SRE, a vendor CTO, and an internal customer in the same week.
• Comfort operating in a 24/7 production environment where storage incidents directly impact GPU revenue, with a security-first approach baked into every build.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Proven background in designing or managing storage solutions for AI training or inference at 10k+ GPU scale, demonstrating clear improvements in GPU utilization or reducing I/O bottlenecks.
• Open-source contributions or maintainership in Lustre, NFS, SPDK, NVMe / NVMe-oF, CSI, Ceph, MinIO, RocksDB, or related projects.
• Built or led a disaggregated-inference or Inference-Time-Compute storage architecture — KV caching to fast in-cluster or GPU-adjacent storage, WORM at scale, storage-aware scheduling, or database-integrated inference.
• Public technical contributions — patents, peer-reviewed papers (FAST, SOSP, NSDI, OSDI, ATC), keynote talks, or RFCs — that demonstrate expertise and leadership in storage for AI infrastructure.

NVIDIA led the way in accelerated computing. Today, our AI infrastructure drives global intelligence, changing industries worldwide. The AI Cloud Storage group forms the base that maintains the world's largest GPU fleet's productivity. Every model trained, every inference served, and every checkpoint saved passes through systems we develop, construct, and manage.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 16, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Executive Search function partners with senior business leaders to identify, assess, and attract executive talent for critical leadership positions across the organization. The team combines executive search expertise, talent market intelligence, executive research, and strategic talent advisory capabilities to support leadership hiring decisions, succession planning, and long-term talent strategies.

This position is based in the United States and operates in a remote work environment. The role collaborates closely with Hiring Managers, Human Resources, Talent Management, and executive stakeholders while supporting executive searches across multiple functions and business areas.

Occasional travel may be required.

As an Executive Search Consultant, you will lead executive talent research, sourcing, and market intelligence activities that support critical leadership hiring initiatives. Working closely with the Director of Global Executive Search and business stakeholders, you will identify and engage senior-level talent, provide data-driven market insights, and help build executive talent pipelines that support both current and future organizational needs.

Primary Responsibilities

• Partner with Hiring Managers and stakeholders to define executive search strategies, leadership requirements, and candidate profiles for executive-level hiring initiatives.
• Develop and execute research strategies to map target industries, competitor organizations, and executive talent pools.
• Identify, evaluate, and engage executive candidates through advanced sourcing methodologies, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search techniques, networking, and market mapping.
• Create and maintain executive talent pipelines and target company lists to support current searches and long-term succession planning efforts.
• Conduct initial candidate assessments to evaluate qualifications, leadership experience, career interests, and alignment with search criteria.
• Gather, analyze, and communicate market intelligence, including talent availability, competitive landscapes, and compensation trends, to inform hiring strategies.
• Prepare and present executive search updates, talent market analyses, candidate pipeline reports, and strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
• Maintain accurate and current candidate, company, and search activity data within Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of experience in search, recruitment, or talent sourcing focused on leadership and executive-level talent; OR Advanced degree and 8+ years of experience in search, recruitment, or talent sourcing focused on leadership and executive-level talent.
• Experience conducting executive talent research, market mapping, and proactive sourcing for leadership-level positions.
• Experience utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced Boolean search techniques.
• Experience conducting candidate assessments and managing executive-level candidate engagement throughout the search process.
• Experience presenting executive talent market insights, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline updates to business stakeholders and senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong preference for experience recruiting executive-level talent within the medical technology, medical device, healthcare technology, or life sciences industries.
• Experience within a retained executive search firm, boutique executive search organization, or corporate executive recruiting function.
• Master's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related business discipline.
• Experience supporting executive succession planning and long-term leadership pipeline strategies.
• Knowledge of executive compensation benchmarking, competitive talent analysis, and leadership market trends.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

jobs.title: Service Improvement Manager - Evinova
jobs.description:
Transform billions of patients’ lives through technology, data and latest ways of working. You’re disruptive, decisive and transformative. Someone who’s excited to use technology to improve patients’ health. We’re building a new healthtech business – Evinova, a fully-owned subsidiary of AstraZeneca Group.

Evinova delivers market-leading digital health solutions that are science-based, evidence-led, and centered on human experience. Smart risks and quick decisions come together to accelerate innovation across the life sciences sector. Be part of a diverse team that pushes the boundaries of science by digitally empowering a deeper understanding of the patients we’re helping. Launch innovative digital solutions that improve the patient experience and deliver better health outcomes. Together, we have the opportunity to combine deep scientific expertise with digital and artificial intelligence to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards across the sector.

Customer Experience is crucial to Evinova success, and we are building our technology, processes and culture on ensuring maximum value realization for customers, anchored in “lovable” on-boarding journeys for new customers and world-class, groundbreaking customer service and support for existing customers.

The Service Improvement Manager will own the continuous improvement agenda across Evinova’s Service organisation, using customer insight, operational data and emerging digital capabilities to improve service quality, customer experience, efficiency and scalability.

Working across Service Operations, Service Design, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality, Regulatory and external partners, the role will identify systemic issues and opportunities, prioritise improvement initiatives and lead them through to measurable outcomes.

A key focus will be the use of AI, automation and service intelligence to reduce avoidable demand, improve customer experience, increase operational efficiency and enable Evinova’s services to scale effectively.

Continuous Service Improvement

• Own the Service Improvement backlog and roadmap, maintaining a clear view of improvement opportunities, priorities, owners and progress.
• Review service performance, customer feedback, incidents, complaints and case trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
• Lead regular Service Improvement reviews, using service insight to agree priorities, actions and owners, and drive agreed improvements through to completion.
• Use root-cause analysis to identify why problems are occurring and drive practical, sustainable solutions.
• Measure and report the impact of improvements on repeat contacts, avoidable DSATs, incident recurrence, SLA performance, operational efficiency and other agreed improvement benefits.
• See opportunities to simplify and standardise processes across customers, studies and markets.
• Lead vendor POCs for new tooling and service improvement opportunities, in partnership with Service Operations & Vendor Governance
• Own delivery of the Service monitoring and alerting roadmap, building on the agreed monitoring framework, and drive implementation with Engineering
• Identify and drive service and process improvements across Device & Logistics and other operational areas.

Operations Enablement

• Partner with Project Managers to provide the service insight, information and reporting needed to support effective operational management.
• Provide visibility of service performance, trends, risks, recurring issues and customer feedback, highlighting areas requiring attention or intervention.
• Identify operational issues affecting study delivery and coordinate with the relevant Service, Product, Engineering and other teams to drive resolution.
• Support Project Managers with service-related inputs for study reviews, customer meetings and operational decision-making.

Customer Experience & Success

• Use CSAT, customer feedback, complaints and support data to identify and address customer struggles.
• Partner with Project Managers, Support & Service team, Product and Engineering to reduce recurring issues and improve customer outcomes
• Translate customer insight into service and process improvements that reduce customer effort and improve service quality.
• Track the impact of improvements on customer experience and operational performance.

Data, AI & Automation

• Find opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual effort, avoidable demand and improve service quality.
• Own the Service automation improvement backlog, seeing opportunities to reduce manual effort, avoidable demand and improve service quality.
• Lead the identification and implementation of service intelligence and automation opportunities.

GxP, Quality & Regulatory

• Partner with Quality and Regulatory to assess the implications of proposed service and process changes.
• Identify when specialist Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Compliance input is required and ensure the right collaborators are engaged.
• Identify and drive service improvements arising from audits, compliance findings, CAPAs and quality issues.

Service Improvement Leadership

• Bring together Service, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality, Regulatory and external partners to resolve systemic service issues.
• Provide Service leadership with clear recommendations, risks and decisions required.
• Prioritise improvement opportunities based on customer impact, operational benefit, risk and effort.
• Build a culture of continuous improvement by challenging existing ways of working and sharing lessons and good practice.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree
• Minimum 6+ years experience
• Significant experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, clinical research, digital health, medical devices or another highly regulated environment.
• Strong practical experience working with GxP principles and quality/compliance requirements.
• Experience working with Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Compliance teams in a regulated environment.
• ITIL certified with practical experience working in a structured ITIL Service Management environment and leading or delivering Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
• Proven experience leading Continuous Service Improvement (CSI), operational excellence or service transformation initiatives within a Service Management environment.
• Experience using data and customer insight to identify problems and deliver measurable improvements.
• Experience with AI, automation and digital technologies applied to service or operational improvement.
• Strong understanding of customer service and service operations.
• Ability to turn complex operational, customer, quality and regulatory information into clear recommendations and practical actions.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
• Strong customer management and influencing skills, including experience working across global, cross-functional teams.
• Experience with service management, analytics or CRM platforms such as Service Cloud, Power BI or equivalent is desirable.
• Nice to have - Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent continuous improvement experience

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Why Evinova (AstraZeneca)?

Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. Together, we accelerate the delivery of life-changing medicines, improve the design and delivery of clinical trials for better patient experiences and outcomes, and think more holistically about patient care before, during, and after treatment.

Evinova represents a unique opportunity to deliver meaningful outcomes with digital and AI to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards for the sector. We work a minimum of three days per week from the office to maintain the pace, connection, and creative friction that builds great products, while respecting individual flexibility.

Join us on our journey of building a new kind of health tech business to reset expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. This means opening new ways to work, pioneering cutting-edge methods, and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey

An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is looking for a highly motivated Datacenter Systems Architect to join our multifaceted and innovative System Engineering Team to craft the blueprints for the next generation of NVIDIA GPU based AI Super Computing Datacenters. The architect plays a key role in defining and driving tradeoffs in high-performance datacenter design focused on all aspects including power, cooling and layout. The system architect drives collaboration working system engineering and leadership to build designs for production clusters and as blueprints for others. In addition, the architect interacts closely with outstanding technical program managers, engineers, and the best leading technical specialists in their domain while becoming an integral member of a global collaborative team.

What you’ll be doing:

• Help create and deploy NVIDIA’s reference AI Super Computer datacenter designs
• Define key engineering requirements and specifications to drive collaboration with system leads, customer requirements and engagements, marketing and application engineers
• Provide requirements, engineering responses, feasibility analysis, present options and ensure the datacenter designs meet the optimal balance of performance, quality, scalability, re-use, reliability, cost and time-to-market
• Document designs and plans to encourage collaboration with other design teams and as a reference for future deployments
• Provide status updates and communicate issues internally providing recommendations as a key part of the team to help with tough trade-offs

What we need to see:

• BS (Masters preferred) in Applied Science or Engineering (or equivalent experience)
• 8+ years of overall experience
• Technical knowledge of datacenter design and familiarity power and cooling technologies
• In depth understanding of the relevant datacenter industry partners, OEM and ODM, vendors and competitors
• Strong communication, verbal, and written skills while working closely with key architects and data center deployment teams to align on product requirements
• Team oriented with a "can do" attitude, highly enthusiastic in solving multi-disciplinary challenges

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

We are looking for a highly motivated senior software engineer for an exciting role in our communication libraries and network software team. The position will be part of a fast-paced crew that develops and maintains software for complex heterogeneous computing systems that power disruptive products in High Performance Computing and Deep Learning.

What you will be doing:

• Design, implement and maintain highly-optimized communication runtimes for Deep Learning frameworks (e.g. NCCL for TensorFlow/Pytorch) and HPC programming interfaces (e.g. UCX for MPI/OpenSHMEM) on GPU clusters.
• Participating in and contributing to parallel programming interface specifications like MPI/OpenSHMEM.
• Design, implement and maintain system software that enables interactions among GPUs and interactions between GPUs and other system components.
• Creating proof-of-concepts to evaluate and motivate extensions in programming models, new designs in runtimes and new features in hardware.

• M.S./Ph.D. degree in CS/CE or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Excellent C/C++ programming and debugging skills.
• Strong experience with Linux.
• Expert understanding of computer system architecture and operating systems.
• Experience with parallel programming interfaces and communication runtimes.
• Ability and flexibility to work and communicate effectively in a multi-national, multi-time-zone corporate environment.

• Deep understanding of technology and passionate about what you do.

• Experience with Deep Learning Frameworks such PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.

jobs.title: MEX Manager Jurídico Productos
jobs.description:
MEX Manager Jurídico Productos

Country: Mexico

ES EL MOMENTO

Santander (www.santander.com) está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología, y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo, la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar.

Esto es más que un cambio estratégico: es una oportunidad para crecer, aprender y generar un impacto real.

Nuestra misión es contribuir a que más personas y empresas prosperen. Adoptamos una sólida cultura de riesgos y esperamos que todos nuestros equipos asuman un enfoque proactivo y responsable en la gestión del riesgo.

Somos Banco Santander México, institución financiera líder que, a través de más de 160 años de reinvención, ha llegado a ser una organización sin fronteras con presencia en más de 40 países, 95 nacionalidades y equipos multiculturales que comparten 4 idiomas.

EL IMPACTO QUE GENERARÁS

Estamos buscando un/a MANAGER JURÍDICO DE PRODUCTOS con base en Corporativo Santa Fe, CDMX

Serás responsable de brindar asesoría jurídica estratégica para el desarrollo, estructuración, implementación y evolución de productos financieros, garantizando el cumplimiento regulatorio, la mitigación del riesgo legal y la generación de soluciones innovadoras que impulsen los objetivos del negocio

Estamos redefiniendo nuestra forma de trabajar a través de la innovación, la tecnología de última generación, la colaboración y la libertad de explorar nuevas ideas.

En este puesto, tus principales responsabilidades incluirán:

• Asesorar a las áreas de negocio en el diseño y operación de productos financieros de captación y tarjetas de crédito.
• Interpretar y aplicar la normativa financiera relacionada con productos bancarios.
• Elaborar, revisar y actualizar contratos y documentación jurídica asociada a productos financieros.
• Atender requerimientos regulatorios y gestionar interacciones con autoridades financieras.
• Identificar y mitigar riesgos legales asociados a productos, campañas y alianzas comerciales.
• Proporcionar acompañamiento jurídico a dominios de negocio bajo metodologías ágiles.
• Diseñar soluciones legales que permitan la implementación eficiente de iniciativas estratégicas del banco.

LO QUE APORTARÁS AL EQUIPO

Nuestra gente es nuestra mayor fortaleza. Cada persona contribuye con perspectivas únicas que nos hacen más fuertes como equipo y como organización. Valoramos quiénes son y potenciamos lo que aportan.

Los siguientes requisitos representan los conocimientos, habilidades y competencias esenciales para este puesto.

Experiencia profesional

• Experiencia en jurídico de productos financieros o normativo financiero. (Obligatorio)
• Experiencia en atención y seguimiento a autoridades regulatorias. (Obligatorio)
• Experiencia dentro de entidades financieras reguladas. (Obligatorio)
• Experiencia a nivel Gerencia o superior (Obligatorio)

Educación

• Licenciatura en Derecho (Obligatorio).

Idiomas

Inglés avanzado (Obligatorio).

Habilidades técnicas (Hard skills)

• Criterio jurídico y de negocio
• Derecho Bancario y Financiero.
• Derecho Mercantil.
• Contratos.
• Derecho Transaccional.
• Legislación Civil.
• Regulación financiera.
• Gestión de riesgos legales.
• Atención a autoridades regulatorias

Habilidades interpersonales (Soft skills)

• Pensamiento analítico.
• Capacidad de negociación.
• Comunicación ejecutiva.
• Influencia y asesoría estratégica.
• Toma de decisiones.
• Orientación a resultados.
• Colaboración transversal.
• Resolución de problemas complejos.

VALORAMOS TU IMPACTO

Tu contribución importa, y la reconocemos. En Santander puedes esperar un paquete retributivo justo y competitivo que refleje tu impacto y el valor que entregarás. Toma un momento para entender a lo que nos referimos:

• Flexibilidad que funciona. Disfruta de modelos de trabajo híbridos, algunos días remotos, otros días presenciales con tu equipo, junto con horarios flexibles.
• Recompensas competitivas. Recibe un salario altamente competitivo con bonos basados en el desempeño, motivándote a seguir creciendo con nosotros.
• Impulsamos a nuestros equipos a ir más allá mediante oportunidades de crecimiento, movilidad internacional y amplias trayectorias de carrera
• Ventajas financieras. Benefíciese de condiciones bancarias preferenciales, tasas de interés especiales en préstamos, seguros de vida y más.
• Beneficios adicionales. Membresía de gimnasio, centros médicos en algunas de nuestras instalaciones, subsidio de comidas, servicio de transporte desde varios puntos, entre otros. Y eso es solo el comienzo: ¡te contaremos más cuando te unas!

Estamos aquí para mantener tu motivación, ayudarte a alcanzar tus metas y celebrar tus logros en cada paso del camino.

CUMPLIMIENTO LOCAL

Santander se enorgullece de ser una organización que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades sin importar edad, género, discapacidad, estado civil, raza, religión u orientación sexual. Estamos comprometidos en ofrecer un proceso de selección inclusivo y accesible para todas las personas.

¿Y AHORA QUÉ?

Si todo lo que acabas de leer encaja contigo, aplica y únete a nuestro equipo.

¿Listo/a para dar el siguiente paso?

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Assistente de Reparos:

O Assistente de Reparos com foco na área de metalização, será responsável por apoiar na execução de processos relacionados à aplicação de revestimentos metálicos em peças aeronáuticas. As atividades incluem preparação de superfícies, mascaramento de áreas específicas, leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, além de garantir a qualidade e precisão dos processos realizados sempre sob supervisão de profissionais mais experientes. O profissional trabalhará em conformidade com os protocolos de segurança e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.

Responsabilidades:

Realizar atividades de mascaramento para proteção de áreas específicas durante o processo de metalização.

Preparar superfícies para aplicação de revestimentos metálicos, garantindo a aderência e qualidade do processo.

Interpretar desenhos técnicos para execução precisa das tarefas.

Manusear e organizar ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados no processo de metalização.

Garantir a limpeza e conservação de equipamentos e ferramentas.

Checar todos os parâmetros do processo para assegurar a qualidade de acordo com os documentos aplicáveis.

Trabalhar em conformidade com os protocolos de segurança e padrões de qualidade.

Qualificações Requeridas:

Ensino médio completo.

Curso técnico em mecânica industrial ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimento ou curso de programação CNC (FANUC será considerado um diferencial).

Experiência prévia em processos de metalização ou áreas relacionadas será um diferencial.

Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos.

Características Desejadas:

Proatividade e atitude positiva.

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Senso de organização e atenção aos detalhes.

Facilidade de comunicação.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a sábado, em turnos (2º e 3º turno) e regime 4x4.

Diferenciais:

Experiência em processos de mascaramento para metalização.

Conhecimento em programação CNC (Fanuc).

Participação no programa Jovem Aprendiz da GE Celma

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Apoiar outras atividades relacionadas ao reparo e manutenção de peças.

Ensino médio completo.

Curso de mecânica de usinagem.

Experiência comprovada em usinagem.

Curso técnico em mecânica industrial.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos (2º, 3º turno e escala 4x4).

Proatividade e atitude positiva.

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Senso de organização e facilidade de comunicação.

Participação em projetos de solução de problemas e melhoria de processos.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Overages, Shortages & Damages
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Product Manager is a key member of the Nordstrom Inventory Product Management team, responsible for establishing and executing against a strategic capability roadmap for OS&D (Overages, Shortages & Damages) — Nordstrom's end-to-end exception management capability across the inbound supply chain. This role plays a critical function in unlocking carrier claims recovery, reducing vendor chargeback disputes, eliminating manual paper-based workflows, and improving inventory accuracy across the receiving network.

The Senior Product Manager will develop a strategic roadmap, in partnership with executive leadership, and cross-functional teams and execute against it. To accomplish that, the product manager will plan the product roadmap and prioritize the applicable technology backlog, lead product discovery, and measure and communicate results of the feature portfolio in production — all while ensuring stakeholder and strategic alignment.

A day in the life…

• Develop and own the strategic product roadmap for OS&D exception management across the inbound supply chain
• Lead product and technical discovery - driving aligned MVP scope, delivery estimates, and prioritized execution
• Partner with supply chain and transportation partners to ground product requirements in operational reality
• Build business cases with finance and business partners that quantify claims recovery, chargeback dispute reduction, and labor savings
• Drive prioritization and alignment across cross-functional business and technology stakeholders, including engineering and operations
• Define product requirements, process flows, data schemas, and system integration specifications in alignment with north star architecture
• Define and measure KPIs for product features — claims recovery, time-to-resolution, dispute reduction, and elimination of manual workflows — and support ongoing system health

You own this if you have…

• Experience: Minimum 5 years’ experience in product management, technology, or operations
• Technical & Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of warehouse management systems and inbound supply chain operations, including receiving workflows, carrier claims, vendor chargebacks, and OS&D / exception management
• Strategic Vision & Ambiguity: Ability to set a compelling product vision and multi-year roadmap, and to thrive in ambiguity where requirements, ownership, and scope are still forming
• Execution: Proven ability to lead discoveries and delivery across multiple engineering teams in parallel, drive to an aligned MVP, and manage a prioritized backlog
• Analytical Skills: Ability to define, measure and analyze processes to identify improvement opportunities
• Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to build cross-functional relationships and drive alignment across engineering, supply chain, and transportation — up to executive leadership

• Medical/Vision, Dental, Retirement and Paid Time Away

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Inference Team - AWS Neuron
jobs.description:
AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for AWS Inferentia and Trainium, AWS purpose-built accelerators for cloud-scale machine learning. This senior software engineering role is part of the Machine Learning Inference Applications team and focuses on delivering high-performance model inference solutions for customer workloads running on Inferentia- and Trainium-powered instances.

The engineer will lead the development of core serving technologies within open-source frameworks (such as vLLM and SGLang) to enable customers to serve large-scale inference efficiently on AWS Neuron. The engineer will also drive excellence in inference framework optimization and engineering best practices.

The engineer will work closely with model development engineers, performance engineers, compiler engineers, and runtime engineers to ensure end-to-end model performance and deliver production-ready accuracy, scalability, and efficiency across a broad range of models and customer use cases.

Key job responsibilities
The engineer will lead the customization and optimization of open-source inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang) on AWS Neuron—including core framework logic such as scheduling and model execution—applying state-of-the-art techniques in kernel development, parallel computation, distributed KV cache, speculative decoding, and systems engineering to deliver best-in-class LLM serving performance.

The engineer will also influence the team's technical roadmap by evaluating emerging inference research and translating it into production-ready features, and raise the bar through design leadership and mentorship. This role requires close collaboration across model development, compiler, runtime, and performance engineering teams.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Fundamentals of Machine learning models, their architecture, training and inference lifecycles along with work experience on some optimizations for improving the model performance.

Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch or JAX, preferably involving developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, AWS Neuron, TPUs, or other AI accelerator hardware
- Experience extending or contributing to inference frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang
- Kernel development experience (e.g., CUDA, Triton)

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
